subject: They want people afraid to use their right to vote

body:
Straight from the Brennan Center: " Imagine you’re an undocumented person living in the United States. You’ve come to this country seeking a better life for you and your family. Or maybe your parents brought you here seeking the same when you were a child. You spend your life living in very real fear that you might be noticed by the government and be deported — perhaps to a country you’ve never known. " Anything you might do that could get you found out and sent away is likely not worth the risk -- including attempting to illegally vote.
Opponents of voting rights want to feed on all our fears to win elections.
We must not fear our fundamental right to vote or believe the lies and demonization about noncitizens. Chip in $25 or more today to educate the public about our elections and protect voting rights nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091924_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091924_3&amount=25]
Brennan Center for Justice: Noncitizens Are Not Voting in Federal or State Elections [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091924_3&amount=25]
You're being lied to, Team. Plain and simple.
Time and again, it's been proven that noncitizens are not voting in our state or federal elections. All states -- across the country -- have multiple systems in place to stop attempted noncitizen voting. Noncitizens who violate the law face prison time and deportation.
Why is a major, partisan news network plus a major political party and multiple candidates lying about this? Because they want to scare you into voting for them and the anti-immigration nationalist movement.
What's worse? Every day people reach out to us, asking about lies regarding noncitizen voting, like how some states are paying for hotel rooms and busing in noncitizens to vote. It's all lies . It's been investigated and disproven over and over again by journalists and nonpartisan organizations -- noncitizens who try and vote are caught and convicted, and noncitizen votes don't count in federal and state elections.
The people who peddle these lies are trying to use you. They want your fear to control you and make you vote for their anti-democracy agenda, searching for safety in their controlling, suppressive, fascistic arms.
Team: We can't abide these lies and we cannot stand by while our elections are slandered and distrust is sown. Fight back against these wicked lies and pitch in $25 or whatever you can to help us educate voters about the truth nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091924_3&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=091924_3&amount=15]

GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=091924_3&amount=250]
Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091924_3&amount=35]
Need an example?
We were recently forwarded an email from the dark money MAGA group "America First Works". The email was full of scare-mongering lies, talking about how " the sanctity of our Nation's elections is under siege " (it's not) and how we need to " ensure non-citizens are removed from voter rolls " (they're already not there).
This is all a cynical, partisan, racist ploy to make voters afraid to vote and to sow doubt in our election results. Opponents of voting rights only want their kind of voters to show up, and they don't think you should believe the election results unless they win.
Our democracy is at stake -- we cannot let the vote suppressors make us fear our fundamental right to vote or deny that right to other Americans. Pitch in $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can to fight back against these lies and make every vote count >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091924_3&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091924_3&amount=25]

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: update for Peter 🗳
body:
Dear Peter,

By now, you’re probably familiar with the radical late-term abortion ballot referendums happening in multiple states this November, including in:

- Arizona- Florida
- Missouri- Montana
- Nebraska- Nevada
- South Dakota

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/phIKGoAI2Jj8IQTd0v7mxg~~/AAVkMwA~-mhIcUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
Thankfully, Students for Life Action has put our 2024 Referendum Battleplan on full blast in these states using key election materials like:

- Yard Signs – which we’re handing out to pro-lifers in Referendum States so they can be placed in thousands of yards to spread the pro-life message far and wide!

- Ballot Referendum Kits – which we’re using to empower grassroots activists and students to educate voters and help push back against ballot initiatives undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country!

- Digital Ads – which we’re running to key voter groups in each state to educate them about the extreme nature of these referendums. In one of the ads, we are changing the minds of 66% of the young people we reach!!

Not only that, but we’re also busy:

• CONDUCTING GRASSROOTS TRAININGS;

• RAMPING UP DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING;

• HOLDING EARLY VOTER & VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS;

• EXPANDING OUR ON-CAMPUS OUTREACH; and

• RUNNING NON-STOP TEXTING PROGRAMS.

But with early voting set to begin across all of these states in just days, I’m counting on your support to help keep it all going!

So, will you please make your most generous contribution in the amount of $75.60, $56.70, $37.80, or even $18.90 to help us distribute more yard signs in Florida and other Referendum States across the country
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/2s3qHtPwLL0anZEa_g1bzA~~/AAVkMwA~-mhIcUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
?

Our new yard sign effort is going to be a critical complement to our other efforts – much like our Ballot Referendum Kits, Digital Advertising, and Postcard Campaigns — to educate voters and get them to hear directly from our students who are out in their town.

Studies show yard signs are "social proof" that help sway voters' opinions – not to mention remind like-minded voters to vote pro-life on their upcoming ballots.

For months now, we’ve had teams on the ground knocking on doors, making phone calls, and passing out flyers and yard signs... but now is the final countdown.

Only with your help can we make sure these critical Referendum States across the nation get trucks full of these yard signs!

A contribution of $113.40 will put a sign in the yards of 30 homes
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Km3VCKtuXbikaYt9UJ1H1Q~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRoz0BqP4Q_-xm_poSHFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~
;

A contribution of $75.60 will put a sign in the yards of 20 homes
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/j6BM7zODDyIgFXamBaD6cg~~/AAVkMwA~
;

A contribution of $56.70 will put a sign in the yards of 15 homes
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/zg8E1tNLcOXmMjkjy-gheQ~~/AAVkMwA~
;

A contribution of $37.80 will put a sign in the yards of 10 homes
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/xGRtU9hgYfLRsQ9fueC8iw~~/AAVkMwA~
; and

A contribution of $18.90 will put a sign in the yards of 5 homes
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/3WESnx-6BfJj1RLWY9aiUQ~~/AAVkMwA~
!

But time is running out and I’m afraid we’ll fall short come November without your support.

With early voting already beginning in several states, there’s really no time to waste!

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What Trump did in Michigan this week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1951%2E135344%2EJV9lzG)

Tuesday night, Donald Trump held a town hall in Flint. A few hours earlier, J.D. Vance spoke in West Michigan at a rally in Kent County. These should have been opportunities to bring people together, or offer a plan for our state and our country.
Instead, Trump did what has become typical for his events: he ranted about crowd size at his rallies, bragged about his relationships with Kim Jong Un, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin, and repeated the lie that the 2020 election was unfair.
Vance was no better, suggesting that Kamala Harris was leading us all on a “path to slavery.”
This is Trump’s 10th visit to Michigan since he launched his 2024 presidential campaign. And it won’t be the last time we see him here.
Because Trump, Vance, and Republicans know what we know: If Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the race is tight. At the top of the ticket, and for my race for Senate. And everyone knows it will come down to the wire.
Trump’s visit is part of a clear strategy to throw their resources at Michigan. If you watch even a few minutes of TV here you’ll see millions of dollars of attack ads on a non-stop loop.
The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate race. Political forecaster Nate Silver’s recently published analysis said not only that Michigan is a “pure toss up” but also that there may be no state more important than Michigan in this election.
But we are not powerless. We can impact the outcome of the races in this state.

Peter, As the Director of Political and Campaigns here at NDRC, I feel lucky to learn about, and work with, so many unbelievable leaders who have stepped up to defend our democracy as candidates. Today, we’re launching our “Adopt a State” program that will allow _**you**_ to take a closer look at one (or more!) of our priority states in this 2024 election. When you adopt a state to focus on, you’ll receive important updates from our priority races in that state. (And, if you pair your pick with a donation today, you’ll get a custom background for your phone and to share with friends — all while supporting Democracy Defenders across the country.) In 2024, we are broadly working to 1) elect Democratic candidates for governor and state legislatures; 2) combat partisan efforts to reduce the independence of State Supreme Courts and support fair-minded State Supreme Court justices; and 3) enact redistricting reform ballot measures and defend against anti-Democratic initiatives. [**Take a closer look at our 2024 priority states below, and when you’re ready, click here to adopt a state to focus on.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175208/499612455/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **ARIZONA**
In Arizona, we’re focused on the state legislature. Right now, Republicans hold just a _two-seat majority_ in both the state House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process. We are so close. [**[Join Team Arizona]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175210/499612457/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **GEORGIA**
We’re supporting the Georgia House of Representatives, Peter, where MAGA Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. We’ve endorsed _twenty-seven_ state legislature candidates as Democracy Defenders. There are so many extraordinary candidates for you to learn more about. [**[Join Team Georgia]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175211/499612469/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **MICHIGAN**
You’ve heard about this recently from our team — the Supreme Court race here is incredibly important. The Republicans nominated an extreme MAGA Republican for one of the seats. He perpetuates the “Big Lie” and actually attended a “Stop the Steal” rally at the Michigan State Capitol on January 6, 2021. Luckily there are two phenomenal candidates who’ve stepped up to preserve our fundamental rights. We’ve endorsed Justice Kyra Harris Bolden and Kimberly Ann Thomas as Democracy Defenders — two tested, proven legal professionals who are pro-democracy, pro-voting rights, and pro-freedom. [**[Join Team Michigan]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175213/499612487/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **MINNESOTA**
In 2022, _just 321 votes_ flipped control of the State Senate to a one-seat Democratic majority and created a blue trifecta with the State House and governorship. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November. The legislature here has been able to make great gains on paid and medical leave, workplace protections, voting rights, gun safety and more — we need to make sure pro-democracy leaders stay in office. [**[Join Team Minnesota]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175214/499612488/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **MONTANA**
Two of the seven Montana Supreme Court seats are up in November. The state’s highest court has been pushing back on unconstitutional laws — so conservatives are aggressively working to secure these seats. But with State Supreme Courts being asked to rule on abortion, gerrymandering, voting rights, and climate change, it’s critically important that we help elect justices who will protect our fundamental rights. [**[Join Team Montana]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175216/499612490/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **NEW HAMPSHIRE**
In New Hampshire, we’re watching the state legislature _as well as_ the Governor’s race. Right now Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. _The House is considered a toss-up_ and the Senate is within reach. Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. And New Hampshire is the one state in New England that does not have abortion protections on the books. We’ve got to elect leaders who will help enshrine and protect our freedoms. [**[Join Team New Hampshire]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175218/499612491/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **NORTH CAROLINA**
We endorsed Justice Allison Riggs for the North Carolina Supreme Court because she has proven to be a fair-minded and independent voice on the court. She is a tenacious civil rights attorney who has been a champion of every American’s fundamental rights, including voting rights. Her opponent, Jefferson Griffith, has already shown he would push the North Carolina Supreme Court even further to the extreme and supports _egregious_ gerrymanders. He joined a deeply controversial ruling that would have established a precedent for so-called personhood laws in North Carolina, which have resulted in restrictions to abortion access and IVF bans in other states. North Carolinians deserve a leader like Justice Allison Riggs to defend their freedoms. [**[Join Team North Carolina]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175219/499612494/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **OHIO**
There’s a lot at stake in Ohio this year. In July, we endorsed three Supreme Court candidates as Democracy Defenders. Justice Michael P. Donnelly, Justice Melody Stewart, and Judge Lisa Forbes are fair maps champions who will protect fundamental rights, adhere to legal and judicial norms, and uphold the rule of law for all Ohioans. [**[Join Team Ohio]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175222/499612497/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **PENNSYLVANIA**
The Pennsylvania legislature is another _huge_ opportunity. It’s currently the _only_ state in the country with a divided legislature (where Democrats hold one legislative chamber and Republicans hold the other), after Democrats flipped the House in 2022. Earlier this year, States United Action reported that nearly _1 in 3 members of the Pennsylvania House are election deniers_. And when the brave first responders who defended our capitol on January 6th visited the Pennsylvania House, several Republicans _booed and walked out_. Pennsylvanians deserve better than that. We’ve endorsed _thirty-three_ state legislative candidates as Democracy Defenders — if we flip the Senate AND hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform. [**[Join Team Pennsylvania]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175227/499612502/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **TEXAS**
In Texas, State Supreme Court justices are elected in partisan elections. Right now, all nine of them are Republicans — Democrats haven’t been elected to the court since the late 1990s. We’ve got to gain some ground here ahead of the next redistricting fight, and there are three court seats up. It’s going to be a tough road, but we can do it with your support. [**[Join Team Texas]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175232/499612506/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **WISCONSIN**
Earlier this year, this movement won fair maps for Wisconsin. The Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court. Now we have a chance to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. For decades, Wisconsin has seen some of the most brazen attempts to manipulate maps for Republicans who have been desperate to hold on to power in the legislature. Their reign has been nothing short of disastrous for democracy in the state. But now we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly and making gains in the State Senate — our best shot in a generation. [**[Join Team Wisconsin]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93175236/499612511/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240919-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates-NOR_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZjk3ZDFjLWU0NzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wx89Y3lPeTCkhX_BCaxarR7TZa97ysmjA72Iw4O3Yx0=&emci=d96745cc-9276-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=2cf97d1c-e476-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045) **Think about election night: Won’t it be exciting if you see results come in from one of these races, and you know the details of that race and understand _exactly_ what was at stake? clean_body: When you adopt a state to focus on, you’ll receive important updates about the priority races in that state — all while supporting Democracy Defenders across the country | Peter, As the Director of Political and Campaigns here at NDRC, I feel lucky to learn about, and work with, so many unbelievable leaders who have stepped up to defend our democracy as candidates. Today, we’re launching our “Adopt a State” program that will allow you to take a closer look at one (or more!) of our priority states in this 2024 election. When you adopt a state to focus on, you’ll receive important updates from our priority races in that state. (And, if you pair your pick with a donation today, you’ll get a custom background for your phone and to share with friends — all while supporting Democracy Defenders across the country.) In 2024, we are broadly working to 1) elect Democratic candidates for governor and state legislatures; 2) combat partisan efforts to reduce the independence of State Supreme Courts and support fair-minded State Supreme Court justices; and 3) enact redistricting reform ballot measures and defend against anti-Democratic initiatives. ARIZONA In Arizona, we’re focused on the state legislature. Right now, Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the state House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process. We are so close. [[Join Team Arizona]]() GEORGIA We’re supporting the Georgia House of Representatives, Peter, where MAGA Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. We’ve endorsed twenty-seven state legislature candidates as Democracy Defenders. There are so many extraordinary candidates for you to learn more about. [[Join Team Georgia]]() MICHIGAN You’ve heard about this recently from our team — the Supreme Court race here is incredibly important. The Republicans nominated an extreme MAGA Republican for one of the seats. He perpetuates the “Big Lie” and actually attended a “Stop the Steal” rally at the Michigan State Capitol on January 6, 2021. Luckily there are two phenomenal candidates who’ve stepped up to preserve our fundamental rights. We’ve endorsed Justice Kyra Harris Bolden and Kimberly Ann Thomas as Democracy Defenders — two tested, proven legal professionals who are pro-democracy, pro-voting rights, and pro-freedom. [[Join Team Michigan]]() MINNESOTA In 2022, just 321 votes flipped control of the State Senate to a one-seat Democratic majority and created a blue trifecta with the State House and governorship. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November. The legislature here has been able to make great gains on paid and medical leave, workplace protections, voting rights, gun safety and more — we need to make sure pro-democracy leaders stay in office. [[Join Team Minnesota]]() MONTANA Two of the seven Montana Supreme Court seats are up in November. The state’s highest court has been pushing back on unconstitutional laws — so conservatives are aggressively working to secure these seats. But with State Supreme Courts being asked to rule on abortion, gerrymandering, voting rights, and climate change, it’s critically important that we help elect justices who will protect our fundamental rights. [[Join Team Montana]]() NEW HAMPSHIRE In New Hampshire, we’re watching the state legislature as well as the Governor’s race. Right now Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. The House is considered a toss-up and the Senate is within reach. Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. And New Hampshire is the one state in New England that does not have abortion protections on the books. We’ve got to elect leaders who will help enshrine and protect our freedoms. [[Join Team New Hampshire]]() NORTH CAROLINA We endorsed Justice Allison Riggs for the North Carolina Supreme Court because she has proven to be a fair-minded and independent voice on the court. She is a tenacious civil rights attorney who has been a champion of every American’s fundamental rights, including voting rights. Her opponent, Jefferson Griffith, has already shown he would push the North Carolina Supreme Court even further to the extreme and supports egregious gerrymanders. He joined a deeply controversial ruling that would have established a precedent for so-called personhood laws in North Carolina, which have resulted in restrictions to abortion access and IVF bans in other states. North Carolinians deserve a leader like Justice Allison Riggs to defend their freedoms. [[Join Team North Carolina]]() OHIO There’s a lot at stake in Ohio this year. In July, we endorsed three Supreme Court candidates as Democracy Defenders. Justice Michael P. Donnelly, Justice Melody Stewart, and Judge Lisa Forbes are fair maps champions who will protect fundamental rights, adhere to legal and judicial norms, and uphold the rule of law for all Ohioans. [[Join Team Ohio]]() PENNSYLVANIA The Pennsylvania legislature is another huge opportunity. It’s currently the only state in the country with a divided legislature (where Democrats hold one legislative chamber and Republicans hold the other), after Democrats flipped the House in 2022. Earlier this year, States United Action reported that nearly 1 in 3 members of the Pennsylvania House are election deniers. And when the brave first responders who defended our capitol on January 6th visited the Pennsylvania House, several Republicans booed and walked out. Pennsylvanians deserve better than that. We’ve endorsed thirty-three state legislative candidates as Democracy Defenders — if we flip the Senate AND hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform. [[Join Team Pennsylvania]]() TEXAS In Texas, State Supreme Court justices are elected in partisan elections. Right now, all nine of them are Republicans — Democrats haven’t been elected to the court since the late 1990s. We’ve got to gain some ground here ahead of the next redistricting fight, and there are three court seats up. It’s going to be a tough road, but we can do it with your support. [[Join Team Texas]]() WISCONSIN Earlier this year, this movement won fair maps for Wisconsin. The Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court. Now we have a chance to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. For decades, Wisconsin has seen some of the most brazen attempts to manipulate maps for Republicans who have been desperate to hold on to power in the legislature. Their reign has been nothing short of disastrous for democracy in the state. But now we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly and making gains in the State Senate — our best shot in a generation. 2 months to go.

| | Peter,I need your help more than ever.You see, Adam Schiff recognizes that the only way he can win this election is by spending millions to get voters to forget the hardship, the struggles, and the threats to our families that have exploded over the last four years.And now that his war chest is overflowing, he has all the resources he needs. Adam Schiff was already attacking me. And now that the Democrats are flush with cash, these attacks are only going to increase - both in their frequency and in their viciousness.You want to know something, Peter?I hope Schiff _is_ breathing a sigh of relief. I hope Schiff _is_ lulled into a false sense of complacency and thinks he can spend the next 2 months on cruise control.Because Californians have had it up to here with the way he has put himself and his career first, while he’s put the rest of us dead last.No matter what the mainstream media says I know California is ready to Strike out Adam Schiff. And there truly is not a moment to lose.You and I are well past the seventh inning "stretch."In fact, I'd say we're entering the top of the final inning.I'm thrilled by our momentum. I'm strengthened by the words of hope and encouragement I'm hearing out on the campaign trail. But I’m taking nothing for granted. Fellow American, I’m running against a chameleon. From now through November 5th, **it’s critical that we’re able to hold his feet to the flames and expose his true colors.**

clean_body: My opponent is galvanizing his supporters by telling them I’m obsessed with defeating him on November 5th. He’s right. | Fellow American, My opponent sent a fundraising email recently asking his supporters for $75,000 worth of donations to combat what he’s calling a “vicious” new ad campaign to take him out of the Senate once and for all. With everyone pinning their hopes on me being victorious on November 5th, I’m coming to you with a simple ask: will you make a gift right now to help me match the $75,000 his supporters undoubtedly helped him raise? Jon Tester is right - we’re obsessed with defeating him on November 5th. But unlike my opponent, who is almost entirely focused on tearing apart who I am and what I stand for, we are focused on sharing our vision for a stronger Montana with voters around our state. Unfortunately for us, Jon Tester has a knack for hanging on. While Montana has become increasingly Republican since Tester was first elected in 2006, he’s been able to win in 2012 and 2018 by lying through his teeth about who he is and what policies he supports. Fellow American, I’m running against a chameleon. From now through November 5th, it’s critical that we’re able to hold his feet to the flames and expose his true colors. We’re the one race everyone is watching. Make a generous contribution to flip the Senate today. It's been tough to see Republicans blanket the airwaves with dishonest and nasty TV ads – they were even outspending us nearly 2-to-1.

But it doesn't change the fact that I'm going up against his massive fortune — and right now, he's putting everything he's got into defeating me.

Friend,

I am unapologetically American and have a profound love and pride for our Country. For more than two decades, I swore an oath as a Corpsman and SEAL within the Navy to protect the United States of America from all enemies, foreign and domestic.

This is why I am deeply disturbed by what I see happening in our country today - the rapid deterioration of our hard-fought-for way of life and the weaponization of our justice system against those who believe in law and order.

**Mark my words:** The United States of America will only survive if we unite as Americans and root out the destructive and evil forces who want to destroy all God has blessed us with.

The freedom we have been granted as Americans is unlike any place else in the world. We still have economic and civil opportunities because of our liberty. However, that freedom is not guaranteed.

If America continues to fall prey to abuse and we lose our liberties, I am confident that no other country will take up the mantle of defending inalienable rights for all people.

We have a severe problem when our rule of law is perverted to punish political enemies. It’s happening in our courts. And it’s even happening within the administrative state, colloquially known as the Deep State.

When I served to defend Americans’ lives in Afghanistan, Iraq, Africa, and Yemen, I protected all Americans. Not just Americans, I agreed with politically.

_Likewise, our justice system and our government agents must serve all Americans without regard to their politics_.

No one is above the law.

My dear friend Kash Patel created the Kash Foundation. Their mission is to support educational and legal efforts to facilitate government transparency and create a healthier relationship between the US federal government and American citizens.

* Legal funds to support whistleblowers within the federal government and media accountability efforts
* Education of the public in areas the mainstream media refuses to cover
* Veteran and law enforcement financial support

**Good Morning**! On this day in 1519, Portuguese explorer [Ferdinand Magellan](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFvtSAUgOFfAxvmcCR6GRi-xe1-a0dD4aCnQbkRqvHfN206dn6GN-_bc356zrwv__1GrqUy-9D4pNkqBIVmNjK6RITUS3J6xOFhNGgjVzcEsJj6FL3VQBQJ4hhs0oFgfCRvJDsENGARNMCItnv32gKBhoE0BWOFAYrcytF9FN7bSinf5aSjC2WT2a2tvaro_wmcBE7XdXUr11aO-9sFTm3lqqK_Fe_qVwROm18oZ7-rSq2q8tnk4eLr4py5DqMwsGye80-i_T18OvwKAAD__8qSWbw) set sail on the first expedition to circumnavigate the globe. ## Hezbollah, Israel Escalate Attacks
Hezbollah and Israel [exchanged cross-border attacks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQxvGnsTeiuzMxMDB0yZauHa3DPmIqHFuAEvXtK3fu-Olbfvp_3ac7p5yej0_exLe4Tzy39JLJKQJFetL94qMIydCLR0Oj1Qio-9VzAG1NQCEbHEvgIRq9RK3tPER3tX3yBKTBESCAIXcJjA4EEEZBmbXrNMiS2l4u33t6tlVi_tlfUi7zvvXZr60dtRs-Orp1dOPjKe96XucoLc1ZOrqlWliyWnnjqt5cVOYmtSl0qsrRZAtS1OlQeoHROmcQLRpyRAuN1hq-BnQYxtgXvxzvlHOqo-k0PDZO-Y_S_g_z8vQbAAD__z9VYmE) on Thursday after two days of remote-detonated explosions of pagers and walkie-talkies used by Hezbollah.In a televised speech, [Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGv4yAQhH8N7oiWDbJNQXGNu1x7pbU2S-COgAUoVu7XPyV65Wum-EYajb4_t_VGMcV8_00Ptt2XlfYen7waiSBRr3pw1jMjXwe2asJx1gqUHoI1btvV6Gc1gyFEPYPeRmDjJ4_GeRyiRUANBkEBTGguGykDDApGVrxrIzSwi73Uy98Scw_s06s8uV728hiSDb0fTVx_CVwELvl1lNbflcDlPSxwASNwUe84S01OZj6bwCXw_62kREHuIbKXgVqjLDO1Sh_seE9UucmD7lwl9U77P0nfnHosWRYvT6pye8nYKnESuAzVuuOMKcU2TkLD_UExfc72n9U9LX4FAAD__4qicRk) said the attacks crossed a "red line" and declared them an act of war. Israel launched a new wave of airstrikes in Lebanon while he was speaking.According to sources, Israel [spent 15 years planning](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u7CAQQOGnwR0WDPivoLjSlaUUmzalNYaxTYTBAnY3-_ZRUqc-zdH3cVtu6IOP-zueZOqWFrTVP2iZOAgOetGNMxsRkGrIyAH6UUshdXMYTb0Y5aC7qRvs2CuHhKOmDsZVDJtVjTcgQIsJhBRigKldUU6ChBQ9SbJ6YlqQ8zXl9jP5WA_awis9KLc2nU0wR61XYeofg5nBjKuN9Cztnn4yg_ktVsoRq08RA4PZl4wU-IHR8RPjfUNb79nHnV-4Uy6cvq6QHDkeaMWYIi_pni0xmEtN-cXU7B1T_6VUYyeVHpps3PX0IfjSD0yL_UQfft_q31IPA98BAAD__xTMa8Q) the pager bombings, using a complex system of intelligence officers, shell companies, and unwitting participants.The communication devices were triggered remotely and reportedly killed at least 37 people and wounded up to 3,000. Israel has declined to comment on the allegations.
## Kamala Parody Creator Sues California
The creator of an AI-generated parody video mocking Vice President Kamala Harris filed a federal lawsuit Tuesday seeking permanent injunctions [against California's new laws](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL8Gd1jLmmdDQfEaukub0sJ4OW_CGcsmh_L30aVOP9KM5v023wJn3u9v4UGupjKHWPlJs5UIEvWsu9UlIqShI6cmHI1WoHS3OTNEggX0AtGYkYyyaVKDTiYOKwaKHTsE1GARFMCEtl-CskCgYCRFUVuhgVau5ew_Cu91o5S_y5POPpZHl91W63GJ4b9AL9C31vqjZK4cywsQ6Hdql0D_sgj0YAV6ZQT6GDKncu4c5Ep0pPBJcgm7zKFdX1zlFs6TLwmgJmunf93p1qNxznyNk9BwfwTOvw317yNPhz8BAAD__1xYYSg) restricting political deepfakes.You can see the [deepfake video here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskjFz3CAQhX8N6riBBYFUqEjiqHPalJqVWE7ESNwAPtn_PqO7pHMFs_vg8T329-v0iiGG_foLNxqqTxMuNdxp6jkIDnrSjRs8EZBqaJAWTKelkLpZB0Xeq960KEH1gPPcG0_OWysNzsbpJgwgQIsehBTCQn-ZUfaChBSGJC26Z1qQCzXly58U9rqSj5_pTvmypK2Jw1rrrTD1jcHIYPw4qwxGimnf3ssbg7FUrO-FwSg7aXqrjeiNslpaKYGpMZOfSl6YeqnHuULb_qz-YNDaH_VYcLs9SwdRpW0m969TKW-PzlfXPiXX_BCIRc1dpxdwnpR22tjFqK4DY4nQd8qpWcrZqf-WaX8cK3JiYE5_9f185HuOTL08caE9gdsTuYXxOI7Lbdnw-oRvYdzpKI_NmQM_g-BlxUyFY6yUyfF7cJR48vwNN4zIV8w5FH5LlfYaMMZPPmfCZQ37lX-UJg_udoQYQzGWaXHdMMTHD9Sv5-E-wN8AAAD__xywr4c)Christopher Kohls, known as "Mr Reagan" on X, alleges the laws signed by Gov. Gavin Newsom [violate First and 14th Amendment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHOEzEQBOCn8XUb2RuT-124CELX_SBEAV20d97LLfHZwXZieHsUaqoZaar5vr9f3kmipOtn2tm3NV9oafLkiwPUgPZih-BXZuTjwN6MeHqzRhs7bN6xG_ltxpmMdeEDOgoBecaRcbaWwyAeNVrtUButR3SHmYzTrI0-seHFOmU1B2m5HH5mSW3jNf7JTy6HJe9D9Ftr96qOZ4WTwqn3fthrem0KJ07wqAqnxP0VuW1cFE6_4VG5QN8y1I0KByABio1f9UY7RYKNSpEKTwmcoT64Qsswx7zcYKEoay5JCCok7kCpCQTm-0o3rhCpK5yowPlsfn35kb-q45QXCer46ePLkHv9xuU-FB_uXWKUehqV1dedJP471f5P_PT4NwAA__-mGYEz) rights.Newsom signed California's [law banning political deepfakes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEbjwcC6cPEad_valMjAmJ3EYGRboPx9tKlT3eoeHZ2P5_T0HPnY_vudbA1p8kvliyYjESTqSTerDURIXUNWjTg8tAKlm5cdyM_Dox8NdThSH4yZ-x5onLsuwLyGhi0CajAICmBE085eGSBQMJCiRRuhgVauKbefiY_6ohC_00W5XdLeRPuq9Syi-yfQCXT3fbdbutrFv0ege8MFOjACnRoFuu39PVKWB90l7bLwdhQ5c4xF1iTPnCotVa68cfVRRv6ig0qRKciTckh5p1wEuibb9bw5Ri7DKDRsu-f461T_LnRZ_AkAAP__RQho4g), set to take effect before the November 2024 election. The legislation aims to combat election misinformation.
## Deputy Jumps into Moving Car, Saves Man
Traffic cameras captured the moment when a Michigan County Sheriff's deputy jumped into a moving vehicle to help a driver experiencing a medical emergency. [You can see the dramatic rescue here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOhCAUAL8GujWPB6IUFNfY7bVXGoTHygZlo0Ryf3_Zq7ebZJJJ5uc-313KaX98u41sjWV2vqaLZnNDuKGaFQ82EiFJTlYMqEclQCi-2l5JDaM3wkUjY_SjDM6YSP0YlPbS8WQRUIFBEAADmm5xwgCBAE2CvDJMAYVUy9E9S9rrSjH_louOzpeNZ7vW-jqZ_GI4MZxaa92y-LdjOO3UTobTlQKVN_gB2tj63PSz8MOGV0s5p1MPTMFjcyn_N-vnw8viXwAAAP__xTBSNw).Deputy Nicole Miron and trainee Anthony Gross responded last week to a report of a car driving erratically. The [driver failed to acknowledge](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsks1uozwYRq-G7IhebMfAggX6GtqvzY-SqKRhgwx-AacYZ8AQwdWPpsvRbB89Z3N0rvt8L1SruvogNEa2MrkorZowD10CLmE5W8moQiRIVxh5PuEB88BjqybiBKUsGAurghMqxMajFPyiCCoaAPjBSkUECIOQgAfgk3BdCC8EBA84eliy0GGAUlnTr-9GdbbBqp3NhP26NHrVRo21j8GhsUMShyTj97rD57CeRWPMn4dDEtWVPUpVtOhqo7GzrqkqVWLvlq3SxeBqM6mudoEAMD_gsG6sbh2a1GNZmrGz2Dv0xXMIr8cS8x4r7PufTbydoXzb890cjtmXXHZaTgWRQ3bZ3AsC099IPqjaoS_xKY7jVyu9-2X-_L5V7wG9Xp9HXNLmYM_XmWzu9JHdKH9f3u4iSc88HbPx63CqdnkxvWwVtR_Z0Hz4x_6_1G5Oih_fH4_H8NTjlC37UQk58P4euKIWaZzNZ7JL06XZAvlgk_l8xTS52a9Dettj4rJ5v92Kc95sYTlemlyXJxASk_jXdVtfpP4_TlZ9JB9P1bZq4L7DoNZCtT_67b9jmCLyOwAA__9Akrjo) the deputies' lights or siren, forcing Miron and Gross to pull up beside the car.Miron then [leaped from her moving squad car](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGyoyAUgOGn0Q7ncEI0FBTb2GXbLR2Eo54dkAwQ3Lz9zr317f_in-_Pc3laDnzuv20kU7e0WFe50aIFgkC1qN6bjQjp1pORE44PJUGq_jAKvH54Gh8jeFjJ3ddNabjLSY8S8I49GwRUoBEkwIR6WK3UQCBhJElO6U4Bea4pD38Tn_WgLXxSozy4FPtgjlpfpbv96nDucL6ua9jSP_RUc-L61XQ4n3SVDmefbbSVnchU3JtEY09JlCNdRUTrUlyFp9e7MhVRbCPhMzfK4rCNz11E8uxsEBQp73S6T5-Nf10cApdx6hTs0XL43qo_IzWD_wMAAP__YltsaQ) into the other vehicle. _"I don 't think I even hit the side of the truck or anything,"_ she said. _"I did a clear jump in and put the vehicle in park, and here we are."_ The driver received medical attention and is recovering.

On this day in 1519, Portuguese explorer set sail on the first expedition to circumnavigate the globe. name: Jameson Ellis
subject: The case for President Trump...
body:
Here is some ammunition for you.

**Peter,**

We're constantly bombarded with mainstream media lies, bots, trolls, and sheep all over social media spreading misinformation. Unfortunately, it can make our job more difficult when we're talking to independents and those in the middle.

So I want to arm you with some facts that you can share as you're having conversations.

****Trump Administration Accomplishments****

**Unprecedented Economic Boom**

**As of January 2021**, before the China Virus invaded our shores, we built the world's most prosperous economy.

* America gained 7 million new jobs - more than three times government experts' projections.

* Middle-Class family income increased nearly $6,000 - more than five times the gains during the entire previous administration.

* The unemployment rate reached 3.5 percent, the lowest in a half-century.

* Achieved 40 months in a row with more job openings than job-hirings.

* More Americans reported being employed than ever before - nearly 160 million.

* Jobless claims hit a nearly 50-year low.

* The number of people claiming unemployment insurance as a share of the population hit its lowest on record.

* Incomes rose in every single metro area in the United States for the first time in nearly 3 decades.

**Delivered a future of greater promise and opportunity for citizens of all backgrounds.**

* Unemployment rates for African Americans, Hispanic Americans, Asian Americans, Native Americans, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and those without a high school diploma all reached record lows.

* Unemployment for women hit its lowest rate in nearly 70 years.

* Lifted nearly 7 million people off of food stamps.

* Poverty rates for African Americans and Hispanic Americans reached record lows.

* Income inequality fell for two straight years, and by the largest amount in over a decade.

* The bottom 50 percent of American households saw a 40 percent increase in net worth.

* Wages rose fastest for low-income and blue collar workers - a 16 percent pay increase.

* African American homeownership increased from 41.7 percent to 46.4 percent.

**Brought jobs, factories, and industries back to the USA.**

* Created more than 1.2 million manufacturing and construction jobs.

* Put in place policies to bring back supply chains from overseas.

* Small business optimism broke a 35-year old record in 2018.

**Hit record stock market numbers and record 401ks.**

* The DOW closed above 20,000 for the first time in 2017 and topped 30,000 in 2020.

* The S&P 500 and NASDAQ have repeatedly notched record highs.

**Rebuilding and investing in rural America.**

* Signed an Executive Order on Modernizing the Regulatory Framework for Agricultural Biotechnology Products, which is bringing innovative new technologies to market in American farming and agriculture.

* Strengthened America's rural economy by investing over $1.3 billion through the Agriculture Department's ReConnect Program to bring high-speed broadband infrastructure to rural America.

**Achieved a record-setting economic comeback by rejecting blanket lockdowns.**

* An October 2020 Gallup survey found 56 percent of Americans said they were better off during a pandemic than four years prior.

* During the third quarter of 2020, the economy grew at a rate of 33.1 percent - the most rapid GDP growth ever recorded.

* Since coronavirus lockdowns ended, the economy has added back over 12 million jobs, more than half the jobs lost.

* Jobs have been recovered 23 times faster than the previous administration's recovery.

* Unemployment fell to 6.7 percent in December, from a pandemic peak of 14.7 percent in April - beating expectations of well over 10 percent unemployment through the end of 2020.

* Under the previous administration, it took 49 months for the unemployment rate to fall from 10 percent to under 7 percent compared to just 3 months for the Trump Administration.

* Since April, the Hispanic unemployment rate has fallen by 9.6 percent, Asian-American unemployment by 8.6 percent, and Black American unemployment by 6.8 percent.

* 80 percent of small businesses are now open, up from just 53 percent in April.

* Small business confidence hit a new high.

* Homebuilder confidence reached an all-time high, and home sales hit their highest reading since December 2006.

* Manufacturing optimism nearly doubled.

* Household net worth rose $7.4 trillion in Q2 2020 to $112 trillion, an all-time high.

* Home prices hit an all-time record high.

* The United States rejected crippling lockdowns that crush the economy and inflict countless public health harms and instead safely reopened its economy.

* Business confidence is higher in America than in any other G7 or European Union country.

* Stabilized America's financial markets with the establishment of a number of Treasury Department supported facilities at the Federal Reserve.

**And that's just a tip of the iceberg.**

That's also why it's so important for you to be at Texas MAGA Fest next Saturday, Sept 28, and to secure your tickets before they sell out and we're forced to increase the price.

We are the Trump Card.

**Secure your tickets here:** https://jamesonellis.acemlna.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE4UqLMDKF8yQxMUeBt2H6kk_Ugle02XHXLUneg7pN__ky.zeJ01Y2jidA~j_YxY5XK https://jamesonellis.acemlna.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE4UqLMDKF8yQxMUeBt2H6kk_Ugle02XHXLUneg7pN__ky.zeJ01Y2jidA~j_YxY5XK

**For Liberty,**

Sent to: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Unsubscribe https://jamesonellis.acemlna.com/proc.php?nl=2&c=291&m=321&s=cabcbe31a720242486b887158a77876f&act=unsub

Good morning, friends. This is Ken.
Between the last 50-or-so years I’ve spent bringing our past to life in film, and the present stakes facing our fragile, 248-year-old experiment this fall, I can safely say from experience that the 2024 election will go down in history.
From _The Civil War_ to _The Central Park Five_ , _The Dust Bowl_ or _Defying the Nazis_ — in these moments, we had to decide whether or not we'd live up to the essential promise of our nation: a democracy that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

## Judge Allows State Fair To Ban Guns
A Dallas County judge upheld[ a State Fair of Texas policy](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GO6yAQRb8Gd1jjMTahoHiNu7x2S2sMQ4JETGTY4P37VdJvd4urc3S-ruuVYor77T892NYz5JVcjS9ejUSQqFbVebuBN0PHdtA4X8bJDNjd7QhGk3ebu5hJbwAjwHCBadaBJzYzdtEioAKDMMCkUfUKRxNoMGom57RjoYB9rPno650rn1RC-skvPnqXH12y91qfRYz_BC4Cl9ZaH_Kpdm7lfRC4vKfApVSqLAPFQ34o8va9y412SSnlxl6WSrvvDuufLaYUy6yFgtuDYvqY6h_hL4u_AQAA__8Au1vC) prohibiting guns at the event, blocking Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton's attempt to overturn the policy. The State Fair implemented the ban following a shooting last year that injured three people. Paxton then sued the nonprofit entity, arguing it wasn't authorized to prohibit firearms since the fair is [held on property owned by the City of Dallas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGS2yAQxvGnQd160AobU1C4UXcp0lzpWcNKJodAEWvL9_aZc5_qK77mN__Pj-sHpZzK_IsW9vKa6pWCpCdfHaAGNFfTRX_T0fUd-97i6TwcXY_d3Z-DdmT5jDhNdhgYGcm4aI21jt3x1iWPGo12qHt9tGgOBgc3Ue_MiUKwgZXRHJPU7SB3Fn5Rm_J3ffJ2CHXpsr-LrE0NF4WjwnHf98PSys-ncOQCj6ZwLLz_TJU7bwrHSDlTgz-PODNELokb0AxfXGCll9QCDUiEl1VAKtxyDV_QhIRhorRBneANgflRYK05hW-FI21wufR_f1P47DYf1z3lnNrJKqPnhVJ-e-U_-Z4e_wUAAP__C0J0fQ). During Thursday's hearing, District Court Judge Emily Tobolowsky ruled that since the State Fair acted solely in its own capacity to impose the gun ban, it would be allowed to stand. Lawyers for the State Fair [cited a 2016 Paxton opinion](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kb2O2zAQhJ-G6tagljR_ChVp1F3alMZqubKZ0KQh0db57YNclRSpBzODD9-Pj8sH5ZLr9TvdZeqfa7sQ9_ySSwTUgPZihzQtOsVxkGn06II5xxGH2xTcmYWdFW-EveFgdTKjdZ7tOQQyQ55Qo9UR9ajPHu3JookrjdE6YvYsympJubft1G_S5ZP2tbzbS7YTt_tQplvvj12ZbwpnhfNxHKdjJfoTKpxp65mLKJyrHLvCuTSmonBOVArtwO1Z-1vhvHfqAivlDdoKXzfAVIFb7bk-BR6tZH7DQrXmeoXrs-5AHf7q_TMJP5_pKpCES66SYCmNfymcMXjQfklhQQ0uUQArESG6dQQTaNFxcdb4MGxTehy5lLw7r6y-3imXL-L-HwGvCX8HAAD__7vKiMk) in which he argued the Fort Worth Zoo could ban weapons even though it operated on government-owned property. The State Fair opens next week.
## Three Arrested In Murder Plot
Three people have been arrested for their involvement in an [attempted murder and plot to kill a Williamson County judge](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQAL_GdEZmMTguXLyGLq-9Ei32EqwzOMKbAH9_yvXXjqYYzdd9vGNMcXv8x5Ucn3Me0XN802glKAl61FVwkwq2qcg1Bvpb29kGqsVR3xnbWqRGWeU76zsCnAwZDW1_M30VHSjQyoJqVGdA1xpaO2NjdY_eG09CKwqR817zQkwnljld-U177fNaJbcwP4to_wkYBAzHcdRzPg2-CsftowgYNjqKgMEvMQXpX4VzuOSEzIlkIgxFPlNm-R1TkkdecZMpTrTzJZcPKgvtcZ5lwatUuwvPI6YUS2-EVo8VY_ot4T_GvB38BAAA___Tt2hq) overseeing a child custody battle. Clinton Harmon, 38, along with his mother and adoptive father, are accused of planning to kill Harmon's ex-wife and boyfriend as well as the judge presiding over a legal dispute regarding custody of Harmon's 7-year-old son. In March, Harmon allegedly broke into his ex-wife's home, shooting her and her boyfriend. Although he took measures to conceal his identity, a GPS tracker on his car [placed him at the scene of the crime](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtygzAQAL9GdOcRZwFWoSINndOmZA7pDEoEYtDhx99nnD71FruzX9fhSjHFdfqkhZ08b3kgL_HOgwXUgGYwVXCjDrau2NUdtpdzY2usZncZTUOBWhx1i20YRxMaNoiGvLeBuYoONRptUde66dCcDJ7tjWprWvK-86yM5hAl7yeZWfhJ5ZZe-c77yeelSm4W2Yo6fyjsFfZ-LHQUieubKuxXfhSFfcqeksJe5p0Z_Ez7xAHiClvKApLhJ6YES5aZd6A1wCMmn-H7CBPDWwb-KJLDC0Is2yFc7S5sj5hSLG2njJ4WiumvSP4ZdHf4GwAA__8MhGwP). Harmon's ex-girlfriend [tipped off authorities](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGP4yAQRn8N7iaCAeNQuLjG3V57ZTSGIeEWxxae2Hv__rTpt_z0SU9678_H7YNKLc_7b1p4lK-83ihKOfgWADWgu7kujbNOwXQ8mgH91fbBYPcY0YRrct7PQ-_nZO18zWRyII6OTTauKyNqdDqgNrof0F0c2pDJBOcpxiGycppTkbVd5MHCX7Tn-m89uF3iunR1fIhsu7K_FE4Kp_M8L5_Hi79PhRM1KbGywunJ565wiq0s33Orq8BnqRX-vtKd4Q2GJ5-QWKjUHfbXvnEUiA9qd05AIrxswgkibUWowvJqiZvCCX0AGlLI2HvQbHtws7EwkzWAzqeMzgZN1LUxbWeptex-UE7fFyr1rSE_VD1G_B8AAP__wxx5-A) about his potential involvement in July. Harmon was arrested on Sept. 8 in New Orleans, and U.S. Marshals arrested Matt and Teresa Harmon on Sept. 16 in Bastrop County.

**Peter, have you heard about the court case in Florida where equal representation for Black voters is on the line? Oral arguments started Thursday — here’s how we got here:**
[**FIRST:**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93180649/499655875/1243206785?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_FLCourt_email_20240916-AOTL-Red-FLCourt_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240916-AOTL-Red-FLCourt_&utm_campaign=FLCourt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3OGVkNTc5LTNmNzctZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gvtsBbhzKuOutVqcolL7M9-fQqaVb3QS5ABunWfChJI=) In his quest for artificial power, Florida Governor DeSantis pushed the legislature to pass a discriminatory congressional map that targeted Black voters in northern Florida with precision — unnecessarily dividing them across multiple Congressional districts, thereby disenfranchising them in the process.
[**THEN:**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93180650/499655876/1243206785?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_FLCourt_email_20240916-AOTL-Red-FLCourt_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240916-AOTL-Red-FLCourt_&utm_campaign=FLCourt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3OGVkNTc5LTNmNzctZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gvtsBbhzKuOutVqcolL7M9-fQqaVb3QS5ABunWfChJI=) Our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, supported voters and community-based organizations who took Florida to court to challenge the unconstitutional gerrymander.
* A trial judge twice ruled that the map violates the Florida Constitution’s Fair Districts Amendment, saying that it “diminishes the ability of African Americans to elect candidates of their choice.”
* Despite that ruling, the unconstitutional DeSantis Map was permitted to be used in the 2022 election.
* Florida’s Secretary of State, the Florida House of Representatives and the Florida Senate admitted that the state’s congressional map diminishes the voting power of Black Floridians and prevents them from electing a candidate of their choice in Florida’s 5th Congressional District.

[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zh0e8cll3usrf7vksb7mgtrng5ejtmvc31i25fm8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zhmktnhb8cf2mdh7vi0efh82toajskq4clc46lt8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsm918gm9lfdhv3d9svfk6d89mjv4g2bcs7slci0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zc5ef55oph2kpugpm08d2sfaq5ttsh9m9j3okrf0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs)
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zg0sd0a1d6p98jc5la9ngjkmjlfqr6v5m6n7ob30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znpi89h89d2acu4p823ahp08ovpd7uqdagpfe6q0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zl2jg6ut5d83r5mduems47kp4sihbb6690u69ak0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zomb16vp32od6im8pi921njj399lsck4pgtctc4o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c3gm6oj4c9h2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

The election is here, folks. Early voting has officially begun in Virginia!
Protecting democracy is a team effort, and we can’t afford to stay on the sidelines. So here’s what you need to know:
ALL eligible voters can vote early in Virginia, in-person or by mail — and all the information you need to get ready to cast your ballot is at iwillvote.com/va [http://iwillvote.com/va] .
If you’re reading this email, you might already have a plan for when and where you’ll vote. That’s great! (If not, I encourage you to make your plan and cast your ballot as soon as you can — and bring your friends and neighbors along, too.)
But with the sky-high stakes of this election, we need to make sure EVERYONE has all the information they need about when, how, and where to vote — not just folks who are already engaged in the process.
Having campaigned many times , I know how important it is to have enormous resources to turn out voters in every corner of our Commonwealth.
So I’m coming to you for help: In honor of the first day of early voting, will you donate $25 or more to help us build a GOTV fund large enough to turn out a record number of voters across Virginia? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=100]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’re a politics enthusiast, it might seem like everyone knows that there’s an election coming up in a matter of weeks. But the truth is, many people simply haven’t tuned in to this election yet.
We know how to reach them, but it costs money. So I need YOUR support to get everyone to the polls. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks for helping — and don’t forget to vote early!
Tim Kaine

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1952%2E135344%2En6t2aJ)

Well folks,
It’s that time again. The end of the third fiscal quarter of the year -- the final full fiscal quarter before the election -- is right around the corner on September 30th.
And yes, that does mean your inbox is about to get a bit more crowded with candidates explaining just how important that September 30th deadline is. Apologies in advance. In the spirit of transparency, let me take a moment to explain why this upcoming deadline is so important.
I’ve told you before that people running for office are federally required to report how much money they’ve raised and how much they have in the bank four times a year, at the end of each fiscal quarter. And, I’ve told you that the numbers reported at the end of each quarter are one of the best indicators of a campaign's continued strength.
It also gives both allies and opponents a gauge of what flexibility you have for those crazy 5 final weeks of the campaign, where pop-up issues are the norm.
They will look at these reports and either say "Elissa is vulnerable, we should pour a lot more money into the state to defeat her." Or they will decide to keep that money in their pockets or spend it somewhere else.
It goes without saying, I'd rather not be facing down millions and millions of dollars in attack ads in the final weeks.
That is why I am hoping to post a great fundraising report -- one with lots and lots of individual donations. Because that, too, is a sign that our success is replicable, and opponents might as well just stay away.
These end-of-quarter numbers will be published on October 15th, so right before the election. And frankly, the last month is when the funds you donate can be put to maximum use.
So, I hope you’ll bear with me as we head into our last “end-of-quarter” push before Election Day. [**And, if you’re willing, chip in below to help us finish out these next few weeks strong. I would not ask if your support was not so critically important to our success.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240920-1-900&t=2&akid=1952%2E135344%2En6t2aJ)

| | **The Truth About
The Coming Crisis

** This might be your only warning...

According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way.

Despite the severity of the situation, the mainstream media has chosen to remain silent.

And our own government has ignored the dire warnings of industry experts.

Experts like a fourth-generation American farmer who warns of the impending crisis:

**["Food shortages are coming."](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18630/6374453/c87930ad7f9bcb73a6a8d6628c42bdac88782a80/86adb52e865abb7c43be651f6540266d58eb2c9d)

** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months.

The loss will be beyond what you can imagine.

As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever. If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis.

It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Well, no need to worry anymore...

When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits...

You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat.

[**Click here to secure your own stockpile of best-selling survival food kits.**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18630/6374453/c87930ad7f9bcb73a6a8d6628c42bdac88782a80/86adb52e865abb7c43be651f6540266d58eb2c9d)

When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself.

Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. Stock up now on these survival food kits while you can.

* Investing in good-paying jobs

---
Friend — I want to be upfront with you regarding something alarming happening right here in Florida.
On Election Day, control of the Senate and who we send to the White House won't be the only things on the ballot. In Florida, we'll vote on an amendment to enshrine the right to abortion into our state constitution — thereby _overturning Rick Scott's extreme abortion ban._
But here's the disturbing part: Right now, state police are showing up to Floridians' homes and interrogating them about their support of a petition that paved the way for this constitutional amendment ballot initiative.

**As a child, I lived under a South American dictatorship with my mother and three older sisters. I remember the strongman tactics of an authoritarian regime — and _Ron DeSantis is replicating those tactics here in Florida_.**
Nobody's political beliefs should be questioned by authorities. And let's call out DeSantis' playbook for what it is: state-sanctioned voter intimidation, all in the name of eviscerating reproductive freedom.
It's obvious why they are resorting to authoritarian tactics. DeSantis and my opponent Rick Scott — who supports a nationwide ban on abortions — know voter turnout is going to _skyrocket_ in support of protecting reproductive rights.

These are precisely the voters we need to reach, speak with, and mobilize in support of our campaign because we share their values of freedom, opportunity, and the right to start a family when and how they choose — not when and how politicians like Rick Scott or Ron DeSantis say.

**But to win, to protect reproductive rights and defeat Rick Scott, I must hit my next $150,000 goal before my last end-of-quarter deadline of the election. That's why I'm counting on you, more than ever, to give now.**

name: POW/MIA Recognition Day @ USO
subject: Remembering the missing, today and always
body:
Today is National POW/MIA Recognition Day
[](https://www.uso.org)
[SUPPORT OUR HEROES](https://links.e.uso.)
---
USO Supporter,
**How can you mourn someone who you 're still hoping and praying will come home?** For thousands of military families, it's nearly impossible. When their loved one goes missing in action, these families often linger in limbo. They may never receive a folded flag, say their final goodbyes at the graveside or find comfort in sharing cherished stories.
**Today, more than 80,000 Americans remain unaccounted for -- a reminder of the sacrifices made, and the uncertainty endured by so many.** On this solemn National POW/MIA Recognition Day, we honor the service and sacrifice of those who have yet to return and hold their families in our hearts. We also renew our commitment to the promise that every hero will be brought home.
The black and white banner we raise today first served as a tribute to those who fought in Vietnam but who remain missing or unaccounted for. Today, it is a powerful symbol of hope and remembrance for all service members who haven't made it home, no matter the mission.
[](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/yvb0Cwb__NT4/UVU4ZUluVHJTRWRyZkNlcjZKNWNxbjhqWHJoU1pQbmpycjN5cXFpSzIvSVZmdm9mRW5TK29nVkhXNUdVdktYVHl4eXNvSUlYczJPVUtrUkZCZVZxa3QxeFlGeEhFRVVDUVM2OVNZRnhTVlU9S0/V09oRGJmd3REaFVYaFFpd2V3TEh2bU1JNlY0R0xpOWNmUGhIaU1xUmVnQUx0OG1rZjliWUhnNis1eW4yZTdHVTgycVpSemRJN3IyUHNtZjFRajNrcGRPUGpXVGVTK3VKS0)
---
On Jan. 7, 1970, Navy Lt. Cmdr. Michael G. Hoff launched his Sidewinder A7A Corsair from the USS Coral Sea to begin an armed reconnaissance mission over Laos. His last radio transmission reported a fire warning. Then his plane inverted. Moments later, his flight leader reported seeing Hoff's aircraft explode on impact.
When Hoff's wife, Mary Helen, got the news, she would have no body to bury. Yet, she turned her grief into action, leading a passionate campaign for recognition of all our missing and captive heroes. The POW/MIA flag was one of her efforts, and it was officially recognized by Congress in 1989. Today, it reminds all Americans of our service members' bravery and sacrifice.
Thank you for taking the time to remember these heroes on this important day and for holding their families in your thoughts. We're truly grateful for all you do to support the people of our Armed Forces.
--The USO
[SUPPORT OUR HEROES](https://links.e.uso.)
---

Throughout history, societies can be categorized into two distinct cultures: those that cherish life and those that embrace death. A society that promotes a "Culture of Death" seeks to eliminate individuals who disagree with the prevailing ideology, those considered too costly or inconvenient to care for, and anyone who disrupts the status quo. These cultures have been responsible for some of the darkest atrocities humanity has ever witnessed.
Here are some of the largest genocides in history, all driven by this destructive culture of death:
* **Mao Zedong 's Regime (1949-1976):** Estimated death toll: 40-70 million people. Mao's Great Leap Forward and Cultural Revolution led to widespread famine, forced labor, and executions, culminating in one of the deadliest genocides in history.
* **Stalin 's Communist Regime (1929-1953):** Estimated death toll: 23-50 million people. Stalin's purges, forced labor camps, and devastating famine policies caused a massive loss of life, marking one of the most tragic periods of the 20th century.
* **Khmer Rouge Regime (1975-1979):** Estimated death toll: 1.7-2 million people. Pol Pot's regime in Cambodia enforced brutal policies of forced labor, executions, and mass killings, wiping out nearly 25% of the nation's population.
* **Rwandan Genocide (1994):** Estimated death toll: 800,000 people. In just 100 days, the Hutu majority slaughtered hundreds of thousands of Tutsis and moderate Hutus in one of the most horrific genocides of modern times.
* **Armenian Genocide (1915-1923):** Estimated death toll: 1.5 million people. The Ottoman Empire's systematic extermination of Armenians during World War I is often recognized as one of the first modern genocides.
* **The Holocaust (1939-1945):** Estimated death toll: 6 million Jews, along with millions of others deemed undesirable by the Nazi regime, including Romani people, homosexuals, disabled individuals, and political dissidents.

When a society chooses to silence or eliminate those who challenge its goals, the result is what history recognizes as genocide. These are the horrific consequences of a culture that devalues life.
Today, we must ask ourselves: Are we a culture of life or of death?
According to the CDC and the Guttmacher Institute, between 2013 and 2021, over 6 million unborn babies were aborted in the United States. This staggering number puts us equal to the death toll of Hitler's Holocaust, far exceeding the Armenian Genocide and the 2 million people killed by Pol Pot in Cambodia.
The fight for a **Culture of Life** is at the heart of the Republican mission. We believe that every life has inherent value, and as God breathed life into mankind, creating each of us in His image, it is our sacred duty to protect that life.
The Mississippi Republican Party's platform clearly expresses this belief:
_" We believe that life begins at conception and that all life, regardless of age, is a precious gift from God and must be protected."_
Our Declaration of Independence makes it clear that the protection of life is a fundamental role of government. As Republicans, we are committed to ensuring that our nation embraces a culture that values life in all its forms, protecting the most vulnerable among us.
The question we face is not just political--it is a moral one. Will we stand as a culture of life or succumb to a culture of death?

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations has teamed up with Mexico to SUE American gun manufacturers for the out-of-control crime in lawless Mexico.

Not only are they suing, but they’re DEMANDING a ban on production of semi-automatic AR-15 and AK-47-style weapons.

And this case has the backing of the Biden-Harris Administration!

But we still have a chance to stop this this madness in its tracks – **[if you’ll agree to have your name presented before the U.S. Supreme Court by signing your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM immediately](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=fzh6w8898qyl0h4gc6pw2sixt9e254j4ozw9mz7p009snzaus4v0djvrr6rm42327bv194r6yfjev9k19segqoxo639rjl6ijf221uzuj93othtqrn6rnrp8s1ytcc3lv28ix9kgnmpg23nbjub6ysm7pzgj12prviz9ttjjead594pbq&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sk45qq&__onlt=h)**.

Please read Dudley’s Brown’s email below about this dangerous UN-Mexico lawsuit against U.S. gun manufacturers. And take action!

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Dear Fellow Patriot,

With the full backing of the United Nations and the blessing of the Biden-Harris Administration, the country of Mexico just filed a court case that could finally impose the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on America.

If successful, this lawsuit would effectively allow foreign dictators to dictate gun policy in the United States – _resulting in the swift death of our Second Amendment freedoms_.

You see, Fellow Patriot, Mexico – a country that’s signed on to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” – is mad that disarming law-abiding citizens across their country has resulted in violent drug cartels controlling up to 35% of the country (_according to a 2022 U.S. Senate resolution_).

Instead of blaming their own draconian gun laws (_as they should_), they’re suing U.S. gun manufacturer _Smith & Wesson_.

But not for any __AMERICAN LAW__ any of Smith & Wesson broke...

**Mexico is suing this gun manufacturer for supposedly “allowing” the guns they’ve built to be trafficked into the hands of Mexican criminals...**

**...As if there was any way a firearms manufacturer could have predicted their firearms would be illegally trafficked!**

That’s not all: Mexico is also asking the courts to _BAN the production and sale of AR-15 and AK-47-style rifles_.

subject: Tonight's Symposium: Housing Speculation--Why Bail Out What Can Never Be Bailed Out?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sare for Senate
body:
| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240920_symposium&n=1)
---
Friend -- If you were to design a city, how would you accomplish that task? To thrive, the residents of the city should have productive work, education, access to good hospitals and health facilities, sanitation systems and clean water, parks, museums, sports, transportation, housing which is stable and in which it is possible to comfortably bring up a family of any size, inexpensive and sustained energy.....and what else? Certainly not a system designed to bail out "assets" which can never be bailed out! Why are our cities in a shambles? What do the quadrillion dollars of unpayable derivatives speculation of the so-called 1% have to do with the grabbing of incomes through rent increases, or the diversion of taxes to unending wars; or the exploding of energy prices through tricks played with the energy grid? What about sanctions against other countries, and seizing other nations' bank accounts? At tonight's symposium, we will speak with recent participants of a New York City rally who are actively involved in questions of health care, in homelessness, in fights against the demolition of entire neighborhoods by real estate speculators (Fulton Homes and the Penn Central Project), and those who take very seriously the idea of creating a healthy, prosperous city. We need a healthy, prosperous, and peaceful world as well! Join us this Friday night at 8 pm.

To thrive, the residents of the city should have productive work, education, access to good hospitals and health facilities, sanitation systems and clean water, parks, museums, sports, transportation, housing which is stable and in which it is possible to comfortably bring up a family of any size, inexpensive and sustained energy.....and what else? Certainly not a system designed to bail out "assets" which can never be bailed out! Why are our cities in a shambles? What do the quadrillion dollars of unpayable derivatives speculation of the so-called 1% have to do with the grabbing of incomes through rent increases, or the diversion of taxes to unending wars; or the exploding of energy prices through tricks played with the energy grid? Presidential debate, Taylor Swift, Meta credited for surge in Colorado voter registrations

---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Did you catch me on The Dan Caplis Show last night? [Listen here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, September 20, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
