**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Trump pledges he will visit Aurora, where reports of Tren de Aragua gang began](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
During a rally in Uniondale, New York on Wednesday night, former President Donald Trump said he would be visiting Aurora and Springfield, Ohio, in the next two weeks.
“I’m going to go there in the next two weeks. I’m going to Springfield and I’m going to Aurora,” Trump told rally-goers. “You may never see me again, but that’s OK. Got to do what I got to do."
The city of Aurora told FOX31 that the municipality had not been notified of any formalized plans for a visit from the former president.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ganahl: The Republican movement of health, freedom and personal liberty](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_As the 2024 election cycle unfolds, the Republican Party is embracing a new wave of support from health-conscious and liberty-minded voters._
_With former President Donald Trump at the helm, the party is tapping into concerns over personal freedom, government overreach and the nation’s health. A significant figure in this movement is Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., whose message of “Making America Healthy Again” (MAHA) resonates with a diverse and growing segment of the electorate. Joining this powerful message is Nicole Shanahan, a leader and advocate for tech-driven solutions to health and environmental issues, whose influence is beginning to reshape the narrative on these critical topics._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Who is in charge? Colorado lawmakers press wildlife officials about wolves](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado legislators questioned wildlife officials regarding the management of the state's wolf reintroduction program, expressing concerns over the extent of the governor's office's influence on operational decisions.
* Concerns were raised about the sourcing of wolves for the program, with upcoming plans to import wolves from Canada, which are accustomed to preying on wildlife rather than livestock, aimed at minimizing livestock depredation issues.
* The committee approved a bill to keep the names of livestock producers seeking compensation for losses due to wolf predation confidential, addressing concerns about potential harassment from wolf advocates.
* Further discussions involved the legalities of importing wolves under U.S. and international laws, with ongoing consultations with legal authorities to ensure compliance.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Presidential debate, Taylor Swift, Meta credited for surge in Colorado voter registrations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Over a three-day period beginning September 10, over 21,000 people in Colorado registered to vote or updated their registrations, coinciding with Taylor Swift's endorsement of Kamala Harris and a televised debate between Harris and Donald Trump.
* National Voter Registration Day on September 17 saw another large increase, with 11,300 registrations or updates, contributing to over 60,000 total voter actions in September.
* Colorado's current voter registration includes 1,017,664 Democrats, 907,509 Republicans, and 1,900,268 Unaffiliated voters, totaling 3,906,892 registered voters.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In new ad, Republican Jeff Hurd vows to prioritize expanding access to health care in rural Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jeff Hurd, Republican candidate in Colorado's 3rd Congressional District, released a new ad emphasizing his commitment to expanding healthcare access in rural areas, citing personal experiences with healthcare challenges.
* Hurd, running against Democrat Adam Frisch for the seat vacated by U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert, vows to protect Social Security and Medicare while focusing on the healthcare needs of rural constituents.
* The ad campaign, which marks Hurd's first in the general election, is supported by a significant advertising budget aimed at broadening his reach through broadcast, cable, streaming, and digital platforms.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[How engine trouble in Grand County inspired Constitution Day celebrations in Mesa County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Mesa County residents Edward and Betty Baltzer's experience at a Constitution Day event in Grand County last summer inspired them to organize a similar celebration in Mesa County.
* The celebration featured patriotic performances and educational presentations, including talks by Jason Bias of Turning Point USA (and a fellow RMV Ambassador!) and Mathias Mulumba, a naturalized citizen, who underscored the importance of valuing American freedoms and the principles of justice and liberty.
* Greg Haitz and state Rep. Matt Soper discussed the importance of local civic engagement and the impact of local government decisions on daily life, encouraging community involvement in governance.
* The event concluded with a Constitution Day quiz and reflections on the importance of understanding and participating in constitutional principles, setting a hopeful tone for future celebrations in Mesa County.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Gonzalez: Needle exchange site in Colorado Springs lacks transparency](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY LONGINOS GONZALEZ, JR., [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Needle exchange programs and drug injection sites, described by proponents as “safe injection sites” or “overdose prevention centers,” are ideas that radicals throughout the state continue to push upon our communities, even where they are largely opposed by the public and previously rejected by local institutions._
_Luckily, at least for one more year, the legislature rejected the most recent supervised drug injection site bill proposal. Unfortunately, this bill is likely to find renewed advocacy in 2025 by numerous Democrats. However, the push for needle exchanges, or syringe access programs, under the guise of “harm reduction” continues and has come to Colorado Springs without ever having completed state mandated stakeholder meetings or public input._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Walcher: Making computers out of... wind?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY GREG WALCHER, [GREGWALCHER.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I just attended a reception with Colorado oil and gas employees, and the conversation was eye opening. I expected to hear about how difficult life in America would be without fossil fuels. There was some of that, but not in the way I expected. Many of the conversations were not about how badly we need gasoline for our cars or electricity for our homes and businesses._
_There was, instead, a new twist that most of us spend little time thinking about. Namely, all the products in our daily lives that come from oil, though many people don’t realize it. This is important, because the push to decarbonize our society assumes that most uses of fossil fuels can be replaced by renewables. Though it costs more and is less reliable, the technology to create electricity from wind and sun does exist. That technology has been steadily improving for years, and while there are still major challenges, we shouldn’t underestimate the power of human ingenuity. But as engineers and researchers seek ever better ways to generate more reliable and efficient electricity from renewables, they can never make the wind or the sun manufacture – anything._

body:
I need your help to go up against the folks who are trying to buy this seat.
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93202708/499714879/1743277108?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4881-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGViYmY1Ni01OTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ixvktb_NKqNgy-p6TCK-dKjoyVYAp5zRzTZb9qs6GtA=)
Hey, folks, I was looking through our fundraising numbers with the team over my morning coffee and wanted to reach out.
Here in Montana, Mitch McConnell has personally targeted my race, and we’re up against _more than $90 millio_ n pouring in from super PACs and special interests who are trying to buy this seat.
**So with time running out before our midnight fundraising deadline, I’m pretty stressed out about the fact that we’re so far behind our goal. My good friend, Jacky Rosen, told me that this team can always be counted on in the moments that matter most, so I wanted to reach out to see if you could help.**
**[Please, will you chip in $5 or more now – split between my campaign and Jacky Rosen’s – so we can reach this crucial fundraising goal? Every dollar will go a long way toward helping me compete against the outside money.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93202709/499714881/1743277108?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4881-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGViYmY1Ni01OTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ixvktb_NKqNgy-p6TCK-dKjoyVYAp5zRzTZb9qs6GtA=)**

I am and always will be a dirt farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. And I’m damn proud of it. That’s why I don’t take orders from super PACs or special interests. I take my cues from the hardworking folks of Montana, and that’ll never change.

Hey everybody, Today’s an exciting day—**Early Voting has officially started in Minnesota**! Starting today, you can begin to cast your vote and make your voice heard. You have the option to vote early in-person or by mail. Here’s information on both of those:
---
**🗳️ Early In Person**
---
All voters have the option to vote early in person. To cast your ballot in person, go to the following locations:
* **Beltrami County:** Auditor-Treasurer's Office (701 Minnesota Ave NW, Ste 220, Bemidji, MN 56601). Open Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
* **Lake of the Woods County** : Lake of the Woods Government Center (206 8th Ave SE, Baudette, MN 56623). Open Mon–Fri 7:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
* **Red Lake Nation** : Early voting day will be on **Oct 2** , likely at the Covid testing garage next to the hospital. More info to come soon on this. For now, save the date and tell your family & friends!

If your voter registration is current and active, you do not need to bring identification. Your voter registration is considered active if you were registered at least 21 days before Election Day and you have not moved or changed names since then. If you need to register or update your registration, or you have not voted in four years or more, you will need to show [proof of residence](https://votereedolson.us/l/FJDy9pttVcpV) before you vote.
---
**📬 Early by Mail**
---
To vote by mail, apply to have an absentee ballot mailed to you. Your returned ballot must be received by Election Day. Find out more and apply on the [Secretary of State’s website](https://votereedolson.us/l/ZuRFH1hppqqF).
---
**⭐️ Help us Get Out the Vote!**
---
Join us for a door knock on Sunday (September 22) as we go out talking to voters about the upcoming election. Whether you're a first time door knocker or seasoned pro, we need your help talking to voters about the importance of voting for DFLers up and down the ticket in November.
---
[ Sign up to help ](https://votereedolson.us/l/yMIbCxppDXwb)
---
Thanks for helping out! \- Reed Olson

Patriot, on November 5, we have the opportunity to step up and defend our nation.

I'm honored to be a Green Beret, Husband, Father, and small business owner; now, I want to be your Congressman.

**There 's no greater honor than serving my country, and now, I want to serve you in the U.S. House of Representatives. **

Serving in the military taught me a lot about life - honor, teamwork, integrity, perseverance, and the real definition of freedom. After seeing Afghanistan fall, I knew I had to step up. Our country has suffered under failed leadership for far too long. America is buckling under the weight of a failing economy, rising prices, weak leadership, and a constant invasion of our borders. I refuse to stand by and watch my two daughters' futures be ripped apart. They deserve to experience the same freedom and opportunities that I did.

**The America I 've fought for time and time again is slipping from our grasp.**

**I 'm battle-tested and ready to take on Washington. **

Election Day is less than two months away. This November, we cannot afford to back down. We must stand strong and fight back.

_**I 've said it once, and I'll say it again: November is our chance to restore America to the country we know and love. This election is the most important election our nation has ever seen.**_ Everything is on the line - education, crime, inflation, national security, and healthcare.

I wanted to alert you about a growing threat to preborn babies, one that is contributing to the growth in abortion numbers this year.

That's right. Even though _Roe v. Wade_ is gone, abortion rates are _growing_ instead of decreasing. Reports say that a preborn child in the United States now loses its life every 31 seconds.

But then it all changed for a photo-opt.

In March of 2022, I and other female swimmers were forced to compete with a male, Lia Thomas. We watched as this male swam to a title, beating out Olympians and other record holders. Despite tying Lia to the 100th of a second, the NCAA denied me the trophy because the NCAA claimed it was necessary to have Lia Thomas hold the trophy while photos were being taken.

The radical left reduced everything I worked my entire life for down to a photo opt.

But that's not all...

I was forced to share locker rooms with a 6'4" man.

**_This is where the madness needs to end because it 's not just sports where the radical gender ideology movement is dominating_.**

Now, children's literature is injected with this radical gender ideology movement.

Joe is focused squarely on talking with voters over the next seven weeks, not building castles in Jefferson City. And that’s exactly how and why we’re going to win this election.
We need your help to tell every voter in this district the stakes of this election. Flipping this seat red to blue is the key to turning our state around and protecting our rights and our freedoms for generations to come. Yes, I really did write this email.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240920-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240920-2&refcode2=4255_552475_UOP3o8&akid=4255%2E552475%2EUOP3o8)
Hi Peter, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
When I learned that U.S. Senator Bob Casey is leading a bill to stop corporations from price gouging, I wasn’t surprised. Of course, he is. Bob is on the side of families who’ve seen costs rise out of hand because of corporate greed.
[**Will you help him continue to fight for hardworking people in Pennsylvania and throughout America?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240920-2?refcode=em20240920-2&recurring=1&refcode2=4255_552475_UOP3o8&akid=4255%2E552475%2EUOP3o8)
Bob has receipts for why he deserves our support with all the bills he’s backed that have and will improve the lives of Pennsylvanians—including those who didn’t vote for him.
His opponent
* lied about living in a wealthy enclave in Connecticut.
* has millions of dollars of his own money to spend attacking Bob.
* is NOT on the side of hardworking people.

[**Will you contribute $5 or whatever you can afford to help Bob and his campaign organize, educate, and motivate voters in Pennsylvania wherever they live?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240920-2?refcode=em20240920-2&recurring=1&refcode2=4255_552475_UOP3o8&akid=4255%2E552475%2EUOP3o8)

---
Peter, in this time of optimism among Democrats, Bob Casey is reaching out to Pennsylvanians and other Americans who are tired of Republicans denigrating our country and high-fiving the billionaire class—and Bob is offering a better way forward.
[**We need more than optimism to lift us and our neighbors of goodwill. We need to take action in all the ways we can.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240920-2?refcode=em20240920-2&recurring=1&refcode2=4255_552475_UOP3o8&akid=4255%2E552475%2EUOP3o8)
Small donations add up to grassroots power. If we all pitch in, Bob Casey will be back in the Senate in 2025 to fight for you and your family.
With my best wishes and appreciation,
-Carole

body:
Your ballot will arrive in less than a month. Make a plan to vote and to support good candidates! | | | | | [](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=0959eba6d8&e=6484bb6dd5)

| Dear Friend,
I know you’ve been getting a LOT of emails—believe me, I am too. But, the work we are doing is critical and I need your help.
Ballots will be mailed out in just a few weeks, and we need your support now more than ever to support candidates who prioritize building bridges over burning them. We need to raise $3,214 by the end of the month to get our candidates elected.****[**Can you chip in to Governing Group today?**](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=f6e763d415&e=6484bb6dd5)
Running a campaign comes with a lot of costs—especially to break through the extreme and divisive messaging that is all too prominent.
The Governing Group is committed to electing candidates who value good governance, civility, and a future we can all be proud of. But we can't do it alone. [Your donation today ](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=4730dc2eee&e=6484bb6dd5)will help us fund those final efforts—whether it's printing flyers for canvassing or placing ads that reach voters online.
Every contribution, no matter the size, gets us one step closer to success. [**Can I count on you to chip in?**](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=acfab0317e&e=6484bb6dd5)
Together, we can make a difference in these last crucial weeks. Thank you for your continued support of me and of candidates who prioritize thoughtful policymaking!
Becky EdwardsFounder, Governing Group PAC

And the best antidote to ignorance is education and a proven model--which I am trying my best to convey and exemplify from authentic Islamic sources and history.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab27e7b5-24e7-4914-9866-440565ec1a72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## The true meaning of Jihad
Contrary to what extremists and anti-Muslim personalities claim, the word "jihad" does not mean "to wage holy war," or "to kill the infidel," or "to commit terrorism." The word "jihad" means "_to struggle_." The Prophet Muhammad, who of course founded Islam, said "_the best jihad was to speak words of truth in front of a tyrannical leader_." Not violence. Not terrorism. But words against tyranny. Indeed, the only two groups who claim "Jihad = Terrorism" are Taliban type terrorists and Islamophobes with an agenda. Both are ignorant of Islam and only serve and feed off of each other's hate.
## The three types of Jihad
The Holy Qur'an, which is the holy book for Muslims, describes three types of jihad (struggles), and zero of them mean or permit terrorism. These are: the jihad against yourself, the jihad against Satan -- which are called the greater jihads -- and the jihad against an open enemy -- known as the lesser jihad. Prophet Muhammad explained this upon returning from battle when he declared: "_We are returning from the lesser jihad to the greater jihad_."
#### 1\. Jihad Against Self
This jihad against yourself manifests in many ways. For example, getting your college education is the greater jihad. Quitting smoking, losing weight, beating cancer, learning a skill, parenting, even "adulting" are all forms of the greater jihad. Thus, the first and greatest form of jihad in Islam is the jihad to improve yourself and to serve all humanity.
#### 2\. Jihad Against Satan
The second jihad is the jihad against Satan. This is the jihad to preach the word of God through the Qur'an, through scholarship and through dialogue. In the late 19th century, Mirza Ghulam Ahmad, founder of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community, coined this as the "_jihad of the pen._ " He condemned those clerics who claimed Islam should be spread by force, writing in 1902, "_No true Muslim has ever believed that Islam should be spread by the sword_." Islam, like Christianity and Judaism, teaches that Satan misleads and promotes fear and hate. He distorts the truth to create violence. This second jihad pushes back with knowledge, truth, and love.
#### 3\. Jihad Against Open Enemy
Finally -- the third, or lesser, jihad -- is the struggle against an open enemy. The Qur'an clearly defines who is an "open enemy," as I explained in detail in an earlier [op-ed](https://substack.com/redirect/3bf4de8d-c72d-43ef-8a6d-8fd1d0271957?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The short answer is that "open enemy" is not your government, people of another faith or your fellow citizens. Instead, the Qur'an permits Muslims to fight in this lesser jihad when five strict conditions are met:
1. You are fighting in self-defense, and
2. You are being persecuted for your faith, and
3. You have fled your home and migrated to a different country to preserve peace, and
4. You are still targeted to be killed for your faith; and
5. You are fighting to protect universal religious freedom for people of all faiths and no faith.

## Qur'anic verses and Jihad
Indeed, the Qur'an 22:41 specifically commands Muslims to engage in this lesser jihad to protect "Churches, Synagogues, Temples, and Mosques" from attack. And even when fighting in self-defense in these strict conditions, the Qur'an 2:194, among other places, mandates that Muslims immediately forgive if the attacker stops: "_And fight them until there is no persecution, and religion is freely professed for God. But if they desist, then remember that no hostility is allowed except against the aggressors_."
And yet again the Qur'an repeatedly condemns creating any sort of violent disorder or rebellion against any faith or government: "_And create not disorder in the earth after it has been set in order_ " (7:57) and likewise, "_defraud not people of their things and commit not iniquity in the earth, causing disorder_ " (11:86).
And in yet another safeguard to prevent terrorism, Prophet Muhammad's rules of war categorically forbid harming civilians or enabling what is now known as collateral damage, or damage to property, livestock or greenery, or harm to any place of worship or temple -- without exception. Given the Qur'ans strict condemnation of harming civilians for any reason, it is unsurprising that a Gallop Poll found that Muslims are the most likely demographic to reject violent military attacks on civilians.

---|---|---
## In Conclusion
No one wins when extremists and Islamophobes distort the correct meaning of Jihad. America is witnessing record levels of anti-Muslim hatred and violence. Those who promote fear of Muslims with malicious distortions of words such as "jihad" only increase the likelihood of anti-Muslim hate crimes. "Jihad" -- as defined by the true Islam of Prophet Muhammad and the Qur'an -- means a struggle for self-reformation, education, and protection of universal religious freedom. The true Jihad is a Jihad _against_ terrorism. Therefore, Muslims should not censor themselves on a distortion of the true meaning of the word. Instead, Muslims and non-Muslims alike should stand united to emphasize the correct meaning of "jihad" and take back this narrative from extremists and Islamophobes.
We have a long road ahead, but whatever your jihad, make it a true jihad of peace, education, and protection of people of all faiths -- and no faith.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: let them go, now!!!
body:
Dear Peter,

Imagine being thrown in jail simply for being pro-life, all while violent thugs who attack pro-lifers face no punishment at all.

That might sound like it comes straight out of a dystopian novel, but it’s the Biden-Harris Administration’s favorite tactic to use against pro-lifers.

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/0WZaIenrCPWfFI6evawTeA~~/AAVkMwA~~

It’s been months since the Biden-Harris Department of Justice (DOJ) prosecuted six pro-life defendants – each being found guilty of violating the FACE Act, as well as one count of “conspiracy against rights” – in a federal trial held in Nashville, Tennessee.

And while these pro-life activists have been sitting in the slammer for simply praying and singing Christian hymns in front of an abortion facility entrance, the Biden-Harris DOJ has been turning a blind eye to all the violent threats I’ve received – and all the attacks on Pregnancy Help Centers since Roe v. Wade’s reversal.

Peter, when 80-year-old, pro-life grandmas get the book thrown at them, while a radical pro-abortion mob is allowed to do its worst to pro-lifers, that’s when you know we live under a two-tiered justice system.

Sadly, this political persecution of pro-lifers will continue unless we can get the ONE person who can expunge these pro-lifers’ records to fight for them . . .

That person is President Donald Trump.

It’s time for you and me to insist that President Trump promise to pardon these protestors if elected President.

If you agree, will you please CLICK HERE to sign your “Pardon the Political Prisoners” Petition to President Trump right away
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/pYuLdaTuHOdNQkZKHDe5qg~~/AAVkMwA~~
?

As you’ll see, this petition insists that, if he’s elected this November, the first people he pardons are all the pro-lifers, now more than a dozen, who have been put in federal prisons by this out-of-control pro-abortion administration!

And who better to hear these pleas than a man who’s faced plenty of political persecution himself?

The truth is, the Abortion Lobby and their political puppets LOVE to use the FACE Act to “throw the book” at pro-lifers just like those I told you about.

While these protestors did violate the FACE Act, this law is meant to protect Pregnancy Help Centers too.

But it virtually never is.

When violent pro-abortion extremist groups like Antifa or Jane’s Revenge – who threatened to shoot up one of our training events in Nebraska – assault pro-lifers, vandalize property, and even fire-bomb Pregnancy Help Centers, the DOJ drags its feet just to investigate, let alone prosecute them.

The good news is, in the aftermath of one conviction of a group of pro-lifers, President Trump went on the record saying:

“Marxists and Stalinists in the administration got a Washington, D.C., jury to convict five pro-life activists who are now facing up to 11 years in prison for simple acts of protest.”

He followed that by making a BIG promise to pro-lifers everywhere:

“To reverse these cruel travesties of justice, tonight I’m announcing that the moment I win the election, I will appoint a special task force to rapidly review the cases of every political prisoner who’s been unjustly persecuted by the Biden administration. . . so that I can study the situation very quickly and sign their pardons or commutations on Day One!”

Now, you and I need to make sure President Trump follows through on his promise to pardon “every political prisoner who’s been unjustly persecuted by the Biden Administration” on the first day he returns to office.

So, can you please join thousands of pro-lifers in signing your “Pardon the Political Prisoners” Petition to President Trump
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/LF9Haa-sJRsHTCrZ1FkxiA~~/AAVkMwA~~
to hold him to his word on promising to pardoning pro-life activists if he’s elected?

And once you sign, if you could please make a generous contribution to Students for Life Action in the amount of $250, $100, $50, $25, or even $10 I would be very grateful
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/x3NAHDTwXSj2ZqQtO9nfjQ~~/AAVkMwA~
!

For these courageous pro-lifers who are being unfairly targeted, Trump’s promise to pardon them may be the only thing between them and over a decade of imprisonment.

So, it’s up to us to hold him accountable so he keeps his word.

It’s up to us to make sure he pardons them all on DAY 1 like he promised he would.

So, can you please join thousands of pro-lifers in signing your “Pardon the Political Prisoners” Petition to President Trump to hold him to his word on promising to pardon pro-life activists if he’s elected
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/HonjgGaDHxHUCtwxj0hVww~~/AAVkMwA~~
?

And once you sign, please consider making a generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, $25, or even $10 to Students for Life Action
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/ilvdF2AKuBnLcp0qSh_i-w~~/AAVkMwA~
.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Sign your Petition to President Donald Trump! <<

Witchita Eagle: Kansas Supreme Court finds Kansans have no ‘fundamental right’ to vote [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092024_1&amount=25]
Sit down before you read this, Team: The Kansas Supreme Court has ruled that voting is not a fundamental right protected by the Kansas Constitution.
It should go without saying, but this decision will likely weaken legal challenges to future voting restrictions in Kansas and make it easier for opponents of voting rights in their legislature to more aggressively pursue new anti-voting laws.
Hang with us while we explain how they split hairs on this decision, but -- the Kansas Supreme Court said voting is a " political right " and not a " fundamental right ". What's the difference? With a fundamental right, the government has to prove why it needs to pass new voting laws and restrictions. With a political right, the onus is on the voters to prove they are being unreasonably burdened and blocked from voting.
In short -- this decision reads like a " get out of jail free " card from Monopoly, granting a legal wink and a nudge to opponents of voting rights to make it harder to vote.
Voter suppression anywhere hurts us everywhere. Help us defend the right to vote with $25 or whatever you can today in states like Kansas where our democracy is under threat >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092024_1&amount=25]

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Voting Our Evangelical Values
body:
Supporting Harris for President | |
---
| | | At Evangelicals for Harris, we support Vice President Harris as our next President because she most closely aligns with our Christian values to love our neighbor and care for the wellbeing of everyone in our communities. Which is why I wanted to share this [AP story](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=e7f3073260&e=43463f1dee) of Rev. Lee Scott, Board member of Evangelicals for Harris and family farmer in Butler, Pennsylvania. Lee’s story of how voting for Vice President Harris is a part of his Christian witness is a great example of why we're in this fight.

As an evangelical in a rural Pennsylvania community, Lee understands the faith and courage it can take for evangelicals to share their support for Vice President Harris:

**_The easy thing for us to do this year would be to keep our heads down, go to the ballot box, keep our vote secret and go about our business. But at this time, I just can't do that._**

As a longtime Republican supporter, Lee decided to vote for Vice President Harris after examining the candidates in light of his Christian values:

_I registered as a Republican at age 18, voted Republican in elections, and as the election in 2016 came about, I really needed to examine deeply what the options were. **Really, I think what believers need to ask is,** **is following President Trump following in the way of Jesus? Because it is a public witness for others about being a believer. And what we do does matter. And how we act does matter.**

It's important_ _ to point to the really good parts of Butler, which is the people. **It’s made up of small family farms, folks who are working families trying to make ends meet, trying to make the life of the American Dream they’ve been trying to make.** And I look at the candidate options that are in front of us, and **_I want to support Vice President Harris and Governor Walz because I think they have a plan for communities like ours._**_

**_To the same extent that I may disagree with Harris and Walz on the topic of abortion, I may disagree with them on other things, but on some of the most critical things for me they are right_** _._

Check out [Lee’s interview and tour of his family farm](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=e1b917be82&e=43463f1dee) (which includes one of his hens, which offers a different opinion).

We all need to play our part to elect Vice President Harris. The coming weeks are crucial, so we hope Lee’s story of voting his values inspires you to action. Here are three things you can do:

**Pray** : for all those who are courageously speaking out as evangelicals in support of Vice President Harris, the candidates, and our country.

**Pledge** : Pledge to support Vice President Harris [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=6ab1da7b41&e=43463f1dee). If you have already pledged, share your commitment with your friends and family.

**Serve** : Jesus called on us to love our neighbor so we are asking people to do service projects in their community. [Please reach out to us](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=c8366fb2cf&e=43463f1dee) if you would like to host an Evangelicals for Harris service project in your community.

Thank you for all you are doing. Let us know how we can support you.

Rev. Jim Ball, Ph.D.
Founder and Chair
Evangelicals for Harris

clean_body: Supporting Harris for President | | | | | At Evangelicals for Harris, we support Vice President Harris as our next President because she most closely aligns with our Christian values to love our neighbor and care for the wellbeing of everyone in our communities. Which is why I wanted to share this of Rev. Lee Scott, Board member of Evangelicals for Harris and family farmer in Butler, Pennsylvania. Lee’s story of how voting for Vice President Harris is a part of his Christian witness is a great example of why we're in this fight. As an evangelical in a rural Pennsylvania community, Lee understands the faith and courage it can take for evangelicals to share their support for Vice President Harris: The easy thing for us to do this year would be to keep our heads down, go to the ballot box, keep our vote secret and go about our business. But at this time, I just can't do that. As a longtime Republican supporter, Lee decided to vote for Vice President Harris after examining the candidates in light of his Christian values: I registered as a Republican at age 18, voted Republican in elections, and as the election in 2016 came about, I really needed to examine deeply what the options were. Really, I think what believers need to ask is, is following President Trump following in the way of Jesus? Because it is a public witness for others about being a believer. And what we do does matter. And how we act does matter. It's important to point to the really good parts of Butler, which is the people. It’s made up of small family farms, folks who are working families trying to make ends meet, trying to make the life of the American Dream they’ve been trying to make. And I look at the candidate options that are in front of us, and I want to support Vice President Harris and Governor Walz because I think they have a plan for communities like ours. To the same extent that I may disagree with Harris and Walz on the topic of abortion, I may disagree with them on other things, but on some of the most critical things for me they are right . Check out (which includes one of his hens, which offers a different opinion). We all need to play our part to elect Vice President Harris. The coming weeks are crucial, so we hope Lee’s story of voting his values inspires you to action. Here are three things you can do: Pray : for all those who are courageously speaking out as evangelicals in support of Vice President Harris, the candidates, and our country. Pledge : Pledge to support Vice President Harris . If you have already pledged, share your commitment with your friends and family. Serve : Jesus called on us to love our neighbor so we are asking people to do service projects in their community. if you would like to host an Evangelicals for Harris service project in your community. Thank you for all you are doing. Let us know how we can support you. Rev. | | | Arkansas Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders is the latest Republican to attack Kamala Harris for not having biological children. At a Trump town hall, Sanders said "My kids keep me humble. Unfortunately, Kamala Harris doesn't have anything keeping her humble." It's a disgusting attack, and it's unfounded – Kamala Harris has two stepchildren. Sanders' comments are an insult to millions of families across the U.S. – and she's not the first to do so. In 2021, J.D. Vance said, "You look at Kamala Harris, Pete Buttigieg, AOC — the entire future of the Democrats is controlled by people without children. And how does it make any sense that we've turned our country over to people who don't really have a direct stake in it?" With their attacks on Kamala Harris, Republicans are denigrating stepparents, foster parents, and guardians across the country. It's unconscionable, and it needs to stop. clean_body: | | | | Team — you can hear the spitting anger and desperation from Donald Trump’s campaign in their increasingly desperate attacks. As they frantically search for something,anything they can tether to a coherent campaign message with time running out until this election, they picked a familiar target — yours truly. “Shifty Schiff has no right to talk about morals, considering he’s one of the mostdespicable anddisgusting elected officials in Congress.” All because I called Trump out on CNN for flip-flopping on the fundamental right to abortion — no less than 4 times in 48 hours.His willingness to change his stance every 15 minutes on a matter this serious shows that in addition to opposing women’s reproductive freedoms, he has no moral compass or values at all. He only believes in his own self-interest. But as Trump’s spokesperson saw it, that wasn’t an indictment of their candidate, but of those willing to confront him — the same old story for Trump’s entire political career. I’m used to the attacks from Trump personally,team. And now, I need your help to respond to his campaign flacks. Every time he and his team come after me, their insults and lies multiply through their right-wing echo chambers and risk having voters believe them. Team, the Trump campaign is backed into a corner. They are lashing out because they cannot do anything else. Their candidate has no values, no morals, and, we hope, is on the verge of his final defeat. You carried me to victory in the California Senate primary because you share my values — and together, we can beat my extremist MAGA opponent, Steve Garvey. name: Tom Carle
subject: Update Sept 20, 2024
body:
Hello Everyone!
I am hoping that this communique' finds you well and ready for the next
piece of the election cycle! Personally, the work is picking up, there is
more to prepare for, more follow-ups and cross-checks with others, and
always something in the news to catch up on! Oh, and I have never looked at
my calendar so much! Ha!

In the news - Continuing good news economically, the DOW is up, employment
is strong, the Fed reduced the rate by .5% and the price of gas has been
dropping! At the top of the tickets, it is still polling to be close and
probably will be - so, we have to keep the energy up and turn out the vote
this election cycle! We cannot take for granted that everyone will show up
- check in with your colleagues that are 'iffy' on election day! We need
everybody!

When asked about where we are and what we stand for, and how do we speak
to the 'other side' about the campaign. The best answer that I have is
that I am for everyone, that everyone is my voter. I am
not 'anti-anybody'! Long ago, I learned that in most cases, the greatest
good for the greatest number, is an easy rule to follow, and it generally
has good outcomes. And further to those points, I will represent every
issue for every demographic - because we share common ground! Our common
ground is everything that we share as humans - where we live and what type
of community we want. Its our schools and education, it is healthcare, its
government-backed programs like Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and
SNAP, its sports, hobbies and events, roads and bridges. Common ground can
be organizations that we belong to, our unions and workplaces, our wages
and benefits, our churches and freedoms to worship, assemble, have free
speech and so much more!

No matter who you are, you and I breath the same air and drink the same
water. We are a part of a family, on a continent, on a small planet, in a
galaxy that is one among billions or more. We are together, really
together for life, and we need to act like it. Let's be the type of people
that recognize our common ground with each other. And through our common
ground is the way that we find our way back to each other!

I know its hard to have so many of us, feel so divided, when really, we are
closer than we think.

Moving on, here are some updates:

Since the last update, I met with a group at the Labyrinth Press to discuss
the race, I was interviewed by WSKG, I attended and spoke at the Polish
Civic Association, and worked the Democratic tent at the Silver Creek Grape
and Wine Fest! All great!

I just attended a wonderful event hosted by the Hamburg Democratic
committee! In addition to all the amenities and offerings provided, food,
drink, music and speakers, the hosts asked everyone to write on their
nametags what their most important issues were! Don't ya' know - defending
democracy, restoring women's reproductive rights, resolving immigration
issues, keeping the economy going, reducing inflation, the Ukraine
conflict, the Israel/Hamas war, protecting the environment, protecting the
Dept of Education, healthcare, homelessness, substance abuse and treatment
and more were on their name tags! Everything that is important to every
American in this upcoming election, was right there on their respective
name tags! And every one of those issues are issues of mine that I will
work to resolve when I get to Congress! I am further inspired!

I have been delivering signs to the committees for further distribution and
their help has been amazing! Thank you, thank you, thank you! Absentee
ballots are being mailed and early voting begins in late-October, so signs
can begin to be put out next week, no matter where you live!

I know there is canvassing, and phone banking in process, and we have
called all of the absentee voters that we had numbers for and have some
postcarding planned, people helping with events and debate prep, and a
tremendous amount of spreading the word of the campaign - so, thank you all!

This weekend there is a Latin Festival in Jamestown that I plan to attend
and we have made spanish language flyers for distribution with canvassers
and at the fest!

This coming Tuesday, the 24th, we are having a Meet n Greet at the
Byrdhouse in Orchard Park, from 530 -730! Its open to everyone - with a
cash bar - complimentary Byrdhouse appetizers, music, and lots of 'getting
to know' you know who! I am going to tell all three of my campaign jokes -
and none are about Rudy Guiliani!(yet!)

Wednesday, I am back in Orchard Park with the Friends Committee on National
Legislation - which is closed to the public - so, I am sworn to secrecy
about where they are taking me! Seriously though, they are a wonderful
group and they will be asking me some tough questions, if the initial
screening is any indication!

Thursday takes me to the City of Corning for their annual democratic
fundraiser. I have been at events with a number of these people and they
are a lot of fun, and they support their political beliefs with action!

And I will finish the month of September at the Cherry Creek fest on the
weekend! I hope to meet everyone that attends! Ha! Ok, close to it!

In October, things get real! On the 2nd, I am meeting with Fredonia
Student Democrats, then on the 3rd, I head to Elmira for a news show taping
with WETM. Also, on the 3rd, in the evening, there is the Chemung County
Dems' fundraiser at the Hilltop Inn! I have always driven past the
Hilltop, wondering how to get up to it, now, I am going to find out!

On the 6th, I have been invited to speak at the Park Church, which has a
rich history of supporting progressive causes. I have wanted to visit this
church since the campaign began, because I had heard so much about it! Its
a place to be, for sure!

Then its go-time on the 10th, when WETM is hosting a debate for my
opponent and I. I would invite you all for the festivities but, I was told
there will not be a studio audience. When I find out more about the debate
and how it can be viewed or streamed, I will let everyone know!

The last event that I will promote today is the Rust Belt Brunch on October
13th! Its a highly recommended place to eat! We are going to have a
little fun, do a few door prizes, and a quick round of trivia, while we
dine! The cost for the brunch is $25, and can be paid on Act Blue.(I will
leave the link at the bottom) If you are coming but would rather pay at
the door - it will be cash or check, just let us know so that the chef is
prepared with a close count! And for anyone that would like an
eye-opener, a cash bar will be open!

With all of that being said, have a wonderful week ahead of you - meet up
with me when you can - and always feel free to e-mail back to me with
thoughts and opinions that can help me better serve you and the district!

I truly want to be the most effective representative that you have ever
experienced! Pretty simple, eh? Have a great weekend - the last of the
summer!

Lots of Cheer, many Thanks,
and Regards,
Tom

If you pay via Act Blue for the Rust Belt event, you will be put on the
list that we will have at the door - there will not be a ticket
issued...thank you, and see you there!

With all of that being said, have a wonderful week ahead of you - meet up with me when you can - and always feel free to e-mail back to me with thoughts and opinions that can help me better serve you and the district! I truly want to be the most effective representative that you have ever experienced! Pretty simple, eh? Have a great weekend - the last of the summer! Lots of Cheer, many Thanks, and Regards, Tom If you pay via Act Blue for the Rust Belt event, you will be put on the list that we will have at the door - there will not be a ticket issued...thank you, and see you there!

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93216472/499756800/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5N2E0MTg2OS02OTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=99JCbP0bglg3ROrKZYXUKvjIf7Ix5ONfHurnXIjQAPI=&emci=fdb69731-b174-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=97a41869-6977-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=19445147)
Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93216475/499756801/1610638071?refcode=em20240920mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=97a41869-6977-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5N2E0MTg2OS02OTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=99JCbP0bglg3ROrKZYXUKvjIf7Ix5ONfHurnXIjQAPI=)

The outcomes of these elections will define the future of our district, state, and country, and we need to run a strong campaign. [_**We hope we can count on you to join in these efforts between now and November.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93217574/499760716/-1220930019?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTg1YWNiYS02YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9f6rpvNZe7_d6YdrECAEqXA2S9j19JRrafNIuarxyg=&emci=f26b12bd-cd76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=9985acba-6a77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=30230943) So many of you are already showing up for our campaign, and Lizzie and our whole team are so grateful for that. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93217575/499760717/-1220930019?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTg1YWNiYS02YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9f6rpvNZe7_d6YdrECAEqXA2S9j19JRrafNIuarxyg=&emci=f26b12bd-cd76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=9985acba-6a77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=30230943)

We have a lot of work to do in the days and weeks ahead. #TeamLizzie will be organizing to win our race in TX-07 and support other candidates on the ballot across Texas and our country, like Colin Allred, and of course, Vice President Harris and Gov. Tim Walz.
The conversations we have with voters before Election Day—at the doors, on the phones, and wherever we can—will play an important role in the final outcome of our elections. We need a dedicated team of volunteers to support our efforts because the more volunteers we have, the more ground we can cover and the more voters we can reach.
**[_If you’d like to volunteer with us, you can sign up on our Mobilize page for one of our upcoming phone banks, postcard parties, or block walks_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93217576/499760718/-1220930019?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTg1YWNiYS02YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9f6rpvNZe7_d6YdrECAEqXA2S9j19JRrafNIuarxyg=&emci=f26b12bd-cd76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=9985acba-6a77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=30230943)—they’re happening every week between now and Election Day!**
Another easy way you can show your support and remind people Lizzie is on the ballot is by planting a re-elect Lizzie yard sign! [_**You can pick one up this Sunday, September 22 from 1 to 2 p.m. at Team Lizzie HQ**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93217577/499760719/-1808828033?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTg1YWNiYS02YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9f6rpvNZe7_d6YdrECAEqXA2S9j19JRrafNIuarxyg=&emci=f26b12bd-cd76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=9985acba-6a77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=30230943) or you can put in a request to have one [_**delivered to you (click here)**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93217578/499760720/-69614605?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTg1YWNiYS02YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9f6rpvNZe7_d6YdrECAEqXA2S9j19JRrafNIuarxyg=).
When you drop by, you can also meet our organizers and we’ll have postcards to pick up, too.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93217579/499760721/-1220930019?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTg1YWNiYS02YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9f6rpvNZe7_d6YdrECAEqXA2S9j19JRrafNIuarxyg=&emci=f26b12bd-cd76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=9985acba-6a77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=30230943)

As a former journalist, I have a deep respect for the role of a free press in our democracy, and I’m honored by their continued confidence in our campaign. | | | Let's talk off-script for a moment here, friend.

You may know me as Martin Sheen the actor, or President Jed Bartlet from _The West Wing_. Regardless, I'm reaching out to you now about a _very real,_ non-fictional issue: _The fate of our nation._

[**I'll explain more in a moment, but first, I need to ask: Will you donate $5 (matched to become $15) to defend our Senate majority and personally make a difference in the future of our country?](https://go.dscc.org/go/19905?amount=5&t=14&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240920-MartinSheen-SheenFactFictionv2-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240920-MartinSheen-SheenFactFictionv2-Pros-sl1&akid=17563%2E9716520%2ESFx2LN)**

**That same feeling is in the air right now. Something new, unique, and BOLD is just over the horizon.**

_Thousands_ of folks just like you are standing up to support Democrats who are ready to move this country _forward,_ contributing ideas and new possibilities.

That's why I've talked with my good friends at the DSCC who are hard at work to protect and expand Democrats' Senate majority. [**_Right now,_ a group of generous donors are _personally_ tripling _all_ gifts before midnight to defend the Senate. They're stepping up, so please, I'm personally asking: Will you contribute $5 (becomes $15) and triple the difference you can make today?](https://go.dscc.org/go/19905?amount=5&t=15&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240920-MartinSheen-SheenFactFictionv2-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240920-MartinSheen-SheenFactFictionv2-Pros-sl1&akid=17563%2E9716520%2ESFx2LN)**

My time playing a president on _The West Wing_ taught me what our government can look like: resilient, determined, and filled with hope.

That's exactly what I see in top Democrats like you now: The resilience to stand up for a democracy you believe in. The determination to mobilize yourself and join with grassroots supporters across the country. And hope for the future we build together today with _this_ movement.

Martin Sheen

body:
Why I never use the phrase “women’s issues”
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39119%2E3422442%2EhQ6Mio)
Derek,
I proudly bring my perspective as a single working mom to Congress when I advocate for universal child care, paid family leave, and abortion rights. But, I never use the phrase “women’s issues.”
I’ll explain why below, but first, **[will you split a donation between Truth to Power and our endorsed women in this election:_Kirsten Engel, Sarah McBride, Emily Randall, and Maggie Goodlander?_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240920?refcode=em20240920-39119&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39119_3422442_hQ6Mio&akid=39119%2E3422442%2EhQ6Mio)**
Take the example of child care, which enables parents to go to work without worrying that their kids are safe. Our economy is stronger when parents can fully participate in the workforce, and this benefits all of us regardless of your gender or whether you have kids or not.
Of course, the lack of affordable child care options disproportionately hurts women, who are much more likely to be unpaid caregivers. But, when we pigeonhole this as a “women’s issue,” we let lawmakers off the hook for working on child care policy, even though it’s one of the largest costs families face today—and it’s a drag on our entire economy.
**Here’s why it’s important that we elect women. A Congress that looks like the people we represent does a better job.** I’m reminded of the time that I raised questions about how the Child Tax Credit penalizes single parents, and I was told that no one had ever asked about that before. And, the research has shown that corporate boards that have women on them generate higher profits, better decisions, and even faster recalls of dangerous products.
Truth to Power endorses candidates who will fight for what families need, not what corporations want. Yes, that means we endorse women. And with Truth to Power, **_women win._**
**We can’t get over the finish line in November without grassroots donors like you, because all our endorsed candidates reject corporate PAC money. Whatever you chip in will help them stand up to their mega-donor-funded opponents, who will fail to act on child care and paid leave and refuse to protect abortion rights.**
**[Will you split a donation today with Truth to Power and these amazing women we endorse:_Kirsten Engel, Sarah McBride, Emily Randall, and Maggie Goodlander?_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240920?refcode=em20240920-39119&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39119_3422442_hQ6Mio&akid=39119%2E3422442%2EhQ6Mio)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240920?refcode=em20240920-39119&refcode2=39119_3422442_hQ6Mio&akid=39119%2E3422442%2EhQ6Mio)
Thanks so much,
–Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240920-39119&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39119_3422442_hQ6Mio&akid=39119%2E3422442%2EhQ6Mio)**

subject: HUGE problem: Elon Musk is funneling millions into Arizona.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Elon Musk can funnel virtually unlimited amounts of money into Arizona in the home stretch. That is exactly the kind of thing that can destabilize our race and cost us the Senate if we let it go unchecked.
#

Peter, Elon Musk is in the tank for Trump and Kari Lake.
A few months ago he pledged to spend hundreds of millions of dollars boosting Trump, and now we know where he’s spending it:
**Musk is funneling those millions into Arizona. He’s hiring organizers to go out into communities and mobilize the MAGA Right to turn out and vote for Trump and Lake.**
Close races in Arizona come down to just a few thousand votes. That was the case in 2020, and again in 2022. Fractions of a percent of the vote determined the result in both Donald Trump and Kari Lake’s last statewide campaigns.
In campaigns, we call that a field margin. When you can win an election by just a few thousand votes, you can win an election with your field program — organizers canvassing voters, knocking doors, making phone calls, sending texts. Voter contact matters, because it works.
Honestly, it’s a major problem. Elon Musk can funnel virtually unlimited amounts of money into Arizona in the home stretch to reach the people they need to turn out. That is exactly the kind of thing that can destabilize our race and cost us the Senate if we let it go unchecked.
So, we need your help.
**Help Ruben stand against Elon Musk, Trump, and Kari Lake.**[**Chip in $5 today. **Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2d3733f6187495ea5efa25934c5f566&_e=DY-s-zwZWfpANgAYm-3IatpUW5AQF1mep9H_vjQiTLWNrnd5l62rRSJkiKPnoNOG5X0br42Mb9vaK_gf3xjSKLCJdjCKLVyHbdifk4uR9rEvt5dU9ZivsLDqg6yOX_TsJWJ6s6_Jg1doQ9NEfZ84OHE3wFszC4s27w5ERTnUGk1z9503YXTXFNVOsQ7zmMQ3EbT-S3SupMFIZ7adE0VLhCc811cBdvgN1n17JSXvOwS1tfj9N7-YTyjpT75wK1_hhDz6iN_mN6COgVBX0pRg4rLKQ34P8B5PhB0iLpqB_dNl3lAiVlbIBBIqFIStrxpl_tOxCFKuyzcPngDoxp3DKSQ13-GF5kWhZJCcHrHpl3YS2MwGc3oNbbmmNvX8QygnKlVQK90MXPaOlLDGBEoa_ZOKdIdXkqCzrflW8-zjuzBzgzSBS0ePe3iMeZuama2F6aqaFRT5mwYvMMcg9lB9HuBx_9t3lfkB5TpeAGwJ7mc%3D) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2d3733f6187495ea5efa25934c5f566&_e=DY-s-zwZWfpANgAYm-3IatpUW5AQF1mep9H_vjQiTLWNrnd5l62rRSJkiKPnoNOG5X0br42Mb9vaK_gf3xjSKLCJdjCKLVyHbdifk4uR9rEvt5dU9ZivsLDqg6yOX_TsJWJ6s6_Jg1doQ9NEfZ84OHE3wFszC4s27w5ERTnUGk1z9503YXTXFNVOsQ7zmMQ3EbT-S3SupMFIZ7adE0VLhCc811cBdvgN1n17JSXvOwS1tfj9N7-YTyjpT75wK1_hhDz6iN_mN6COgVBX0pRg4rLKQ34P8B5PhB0iLpqB_dNl3lAiVlbIBBIqFIStrxpl_tOxCFKuyzcPngDoxp3DKQyMDVnjaLbMIUJHIikK-8Kj_fzplecJk2ToPr1F2Sf8JaYtdjIyD1YB66iIgeRCA1rp8lkWV76ZBaCo_N5conAfrHJ1q0S0JXw3u91owB4YLYXJedhDopZYMxL76IfzIqG7XypHiDhCIrJptbgCzOk%3D) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[ Check if you qualify ](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2d3733f6187495ea5efa25934c5f566&_e=DY-s-zwZWfpANgAYm-3IatpUW5AQF1mep9H_vjQiTLWNrnd5l62rRSJkiKPnoNOG5X0br42Mb9vaK_gf3xjSKLCJdjCKLVyHbdifk4uR9rEvt5dU9ZivsLDqg6yOX_TsJWJ6s6_Jg1doQ9NEfZ84OHE3wFszC4s27w5ERTnUGk1z9503YXTXFNVOsQ7zmMQ3EbT-S3SupMFIZ7adE0VLhCc811cBdvgN1n17JSXvOwS1tfj9N7-YTyjpT75wK1_hhDz6iN_mN6COgVBX0pRg4rLKQ34P8B5PhB0iLpqB_dNl3lAiVlbIBBIqFIStrxpl_tOxCFKuyzcPngDoxp3DKQhaCCGF-lK58w1kkqWbtR1OmRWrNl17I0qQvZM6vjB2b2BboPefJT52idz-v6I9Khy6izLB-828PIp1zFuSubT0sCVhFbfQvMrrOq0ij-0XZJsuDbDgScvkINuGrigDePWRFvygelvONEM1YM6CuJE%3D)
[ ](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2d3733f6187495ea5efa25934c5f566&_e=DY-s-zwZWfpANgAYm-3IatpUW5AQF1mep9H_vjQiTLWNrnd5l62rRSJkiKPnoNOG5X0br42Mb9vaK_gf3xjSKLCJdjCKLVyHbdifk4uR9rEvt5dU9ZivsLDqg6yOX_TsJWJ6s6_Jg1doQ9NEfZ84OHE3wFszC4s27w5ERTnUGk1z9503YXTXFNVOsQ7zmMQ3EbT-S3SupMFIZ7adE0VLhCc811cBdvgN1n17JSXvOwS1tfj9N7-YTyjpT75wK1_hhDz6iN_mN6COgVBX0pRg4rLKQ34P8B5PhB0iLpqB_dNl3lAiVlbIBBIqFIStrxpl_tOxCFKuyzcPngDoxp3DKTU4Pc5iHR7VWmqnnMZ5TgFcK3MdTH4KlydlvUr0i55ym7_jvNUFtTX956HlDI_D3HbUHKrfJV5Hp_Bg0lVx973Ut-FC-4LQFPjdH-E3U7-AmaIGR1HXvNjSShjVUx6vyNDDqlT19M4MaPM-ktO9TzA%3D)

I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.
Peter, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.
And now we know: Sinema’s out. **This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her. **
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.

It's one of **the world 's first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it's the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7OzIccDh97PiiHvyZfOf0Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0EIMP0TqaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaGVhci5jb20vZC9iZXN0X2hlYXJpbmdfYWlkc19hZmYwMS8_) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7OzIccDh97PiiHvyZfOf0Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0EIMP0TqaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaGVhci5jb20vZC9iZXN0X2hlYXJpbmdfYWlkc19hZmYwMS8_) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7OzIccDh97PiiHvyZfOf0Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0EIMP0TqaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaGVhci5jb20vZC9iZXN0X2hlYXJpbmdfYWlkc19hZmYwMS8_) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7OzIccDh97PiiHvyZfOf0Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0EIMP0TqaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaGVhci5jb20vZC9iZXN0X2hlYXJpbmdfYWlkc19hZmYwMS8_) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

---
**Why the Trump Knife Collection Stands Apart:****8 Distinctive Knives, Each Telling a Story** This collection is thoughtfully[ designed to commemorate pivotal moments from Trump’s presidency](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18638/6374453/e754b73ba823e89d15ff39b2c07dedf21fd77056/8bfb004bf85149afda7d749dd9a92e3096f406ca). Each month, a new knife arrives at your door, featuring a full-color image of President Trump paired with one of his defining messages—from “Keep America Great” to “Save America Again.” Each piece is more than a knife; it’s a statement of American pride.
* **Premium Pakkawood Handles** : Hand-polished with a rich cherry stain, each knife handle is crafted to reflect both strength and elegance, offering a balanced, luxurious feel in your hand.
* **Razor-Sharp Stainless Steel Blades** : Each blade is forged with precision, ensuring durability and a sharp edge, reflecting the steadfast spirit of American craftsmanship.
* **American Craftsmanship** : Designed and forged in the USA, each knife is a testament to American quality, pride, and tradition.

---
[](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18638/6374453/e754b73ba823e89d15ff39b2c07dedf21fd77056/8bfb004bf85149afda7d749dd9a92e3096f406ca)
---
**A Showcase of Elegance: The LED Display Case** The collection comes complete with a **[custom-designed wooden display case](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18638/6374453/e754b73ba823e89d15ff39b2c07dedf21fd77056/8bfb004bf85149afda7d749dd9a92e3096f406ca)** , made from premium cherry wood and featuring a shining gold strip with a hinged glass cover. The addition of **eight built-in LED lights** enhances the beauty of each knife, casting a soft glow that captures the essence of this elegant tribute.
* **Protective and Elegant** : The hinged cover provides easy access to your knives while ensuring they remain protected from dust and wear.
* **Showcase Presidential Pride** : The display case is adorned with a raised golden medallion, inspired by the American presidential seal, making it a stunning centerpiece for any home or office.

---
[](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18638/6374453/e754b73ba823e89d15ff39b2c07dedf21fd77056/8bfb004bf85149afda7d749dd9a92e3096f406ca)
---
**An Heirloom for Generations** This collection is more than a tribute to Trump’s presidency—it’s an heirloom piece that captures a moment in history with elegance and pride. Each knife's patriotic theme is carefully chosen to resonate with the values that define America: freedom, strength, and resilience. Displayed together, they create a narrative that will be admired for generations. **What Our Collectors Are Saying:**
* **“The detail and craftsmanship are unparalleled. Each knife is a conversation starter, and the display case elevates them to a true work of art.” – Lisa M., Verified Buyer**
* **“I’ve never seen anything like it. Each delivery brings a new piece of history to my collection, and the quality is outstanding.” – Tom L., Verified Buyer**

**Secure Your Place Among History’s Collectors** The **Limited Edition Trump Knife Collection** is available for a short time. With each knife delivered monthly, anticipation builds until your set is complete. This isn’t just about owning knives; it’s about curating a piece of history. **[CLICK HERE TO CHECK AVAILABILITY AND ORDER YOUR SET](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18638/6374453/e754b73ba823e89d15ff39b2c07dedf21fd77056/8bfb004bf85149afda7d749dd9a92e3096f406ca)** Sincerely,

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: I’m asking for your support – so let me explain exactly why
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Hey there.
I want to explain exactly why I’m asking for your support because I know you get a lot of these asks from a whole lot of people.
I believe deeply in the power of government to improve people’s lives – but it’s also become clear to me over the past few years in the House that our system is simply not working right now. And because of that – the gridlock, the in-fighting, the constant political maneuvering – far too many people, especially young people, have lost faith in our public institutions.
They no longer trust that our government can address the issues we’re facing. And having been a member of the House under disastrously unstable and ineffective GOP leadership, I get where they’re coming from. With Republicans running the show, we can’t take action and tackle problems, because they have no serious interest in governing.
That’s why I’m working so hard to flip the House to a Democratic majority this November, and it’s why I’m asking for your help today.
Will you make a donation of $10 or more right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I’m facing an anti-abortion MAGA opponent who wants to ban marriage equality and thinks climate change is a hoax – so it’s imperative that I win re-election and keep this guy’s extreme views out of the House. But I can’t stop there. It’s also so critical for me to support Kamala Harris and Tim Walz at the top of our ticket as well as my fellow Democrats running in tough races.
I’m determined to do everything I can out on the trail between now and November 5th, and your support makes this work possible.
So if you’re able, I’m asking you to pitch in $10, $30, or even $100 today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you for everything! I know that we can win if we all work together.
-Sara
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Congresswoman Sara Jacobs
California’s 51st District
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you can’t give much right now, I want you to know that even $1 or $5 makes a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] And if you can’t give at all, I understand. I appreciate you taking the time to read these emails and stay connected with my campaign – regardless of whether or not you’re able to chip in financially. Thank you!

They no longer trust that our government can address the issues we’re facing. And having been a member of the House under disastrously unstable and ineffective GOP leadership, I get where they’re coming from. With Republicans running the show, we can’t take action and tackle problems, because they have no serious interest in governing. That’s why I’m working so hard to flip the House to a Democratic majority this November, and it’s why I’m asking for your help today. Will you make a donation of $10 or more right now? [] I’m facing an anti-abortion MAGA opponent who wants to ban marriage equality and thinks climate change is a hoax – so it’s imperative that I win re-election and keep this guy’s extreme views out of the House. But I can’t stop there. It’s also so critical for me to support Kamala Harris and Tim Walz at the top of our ticket as well as my fellow Democrats running in tough races. I’m determined to do everything I can out on the trail between now and November 5th, and your support makes this work possible. So if you’re able, I’m asking you to pitch in $10, $30, or even $100 today. [] Thank you for everything! | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Can you believe today marks just one month until the start of early voting here in Washington?
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240920-4310-footer&t=1&akid=4310%2E420207%2Egf2FRD)
Peter,
Can you believe we're just **one month from the start of early voting** here in Washington? There’s so much on the line this year, from our freedoms to our democracy itself — we can’t afford to sit this one out.
That’s why I’m doing everything I can in these last 46 days to elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and progressives all over the country. Our campaign is organizing here in Seattle _and_ in several important swing states, because that’s what it’s going to take to build progressive power in Congress.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240920-1?refcode=em20240920-1&amount=3&refcode2=4310_420207_gf2FRD&akid=4310%2E420207%2Egf2FRD)
