In this final stretch, every door we knock on, every phone call we place, every text message we send could be the difference between a Democratic trifecta and a second Trump presidency next January.
And I couldn’t be more grateful that we’re able to do all of this work thanks to your support. I don’t take donations from corporate PACs, which makes online grassroots donations so important. This year, I’m proud to say those online donations average just $39.
We’re working to build a government that works for all of us, not just the wealthiest few. But in order to do that, I need your help now more than ever.

Peter,
If you’ve paid any attention to news about the presidential campaign this week, you’ve definitely come across the name Laura Loomer.
**And, if you’re like us, you probably found yourself saying, “who the hell is Laura Loomer?"**
[**We’ll tell you who Laura Loomer is and why her influence on Trump matters in a moment, but if you support COURIER’s efforts to expose right-wing bad actors like Laura Loomer, can you chip in $25 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93228855/499789392/-593472309?refcode=20240920-EM-lauraloomer&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmU2NWVjODMtNzg3Ny1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JRVMjPbXCGcxghcb8JvtP-xqLzEMskoZz-MCD6lU4lI=)
The debate, a ceremony to honor victims of the 9/11 attacks – Laura Loomer was inseparable from Donald Trump last week.
**So who is she?**
Laura Loomer is a far-right influencer who ran for Congress (and lost) in 2020 and 2022. She has described herself as “pro-white nationalist” and a “proud Islamophobe.”
She has been banned from Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram for her inflammatory rhetoric. She’s also been removed from in-person events for harassment and causing disturbances.
**Uber Eats even banned Loomer for insisting that her delivery driver not be a Muslim.**
Loomer is so extreme that even some pro-Trump Republicans have expressed concern about her closeness to the former President.
**In a mind-bending turn of events, far-right congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene even condemned Loomer’s racist statement that a Kamala Harris White House would “smell like curry.”**
She has promoted the bizarre and dangerous conspiracy theory that immigrants are eating pets in Springfield, Ohio. She has claimed that President Joe Biden is dying and his final arrangements are being made. She has accused Democrats of controlling the weather to influence Republican primary elections (_yes, seriously._)
**In short, Laura Loomer is exactly the kind of person that COURIER was made to take on.**
Laura Loomer lies, spreads hate, and sows division, especially online. Most importantly, she’s cozying up to Donald Trump because she thinks those are strategies that will help him turn out his base and win in 2024.
Laura Loomer operates on the social media platforms where misinformation spreads – but so does COURIER. While influencers like Loomer post lies and divisive rhetoric, COURIER publishes fearless, factual news that makes an impact.

subject: Across California

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7628%2E5257348%2E4qaHSG ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek — My
favorite part of campaigning for the U.S. Senate is getting to meet so
many incredible Californians across our great state.

I may be biased, but California is one of the best places on earth — with
wonderful people who are passionate about our communities, our families,
and our planet.

I’d love to share some images from the past few weeks on the road, but
before I do, I have to ask: Will you chip in
$10 or
anything you can spare to help me meet more voters? With less than 50 days
until the election and this being my first time running for statewide
office, I’m running out of time to meet new voters.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=sept2024_abs_em.a1Ivk6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=7628%2E5257348%2E4qaHSG ]DONATE

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=7628%2E5257348%2E4qaHSG ]Barbara Lee and Adam Schiff

My wife, Eve, and I went to the Bay Area, where we were joined by
Oakland’s finest, Representative Barbara Lee! We stopped at Allen Temple
Church, a beacon of hope and joy for so many in Oakland.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=7628%2E5257348%2E4qaHSG ]Adam with the South Bay Labor Council

I had a blast with the South Bay Labor Council, and I can’t wait to
champion labor rights as a U.S. Senator in 46 days. The work you’re doing
on the ground for working families is inspiring.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=7628%2E5257348%2E4qaHSG ]Adam taking a BeReal with Grassroots Democrats HQ

I got to BeReal (I’ll have to ask my kids if I’m using that term properly)
with the Grassroots Democrats HQ. Volunteers are fired up and ready to go,
not just to defeat Trump and elect Kamala — but also to flip the House and
hold the Senate in the process.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=7628%2E5257348%2E4qaHSG ]Adam and Eve at the Redwoods

Eve and I also stopped by the Redwoods — one of our state's natural
beauties. I promise to be a Senator who will fight to protect our climate
and our nature so that our kids and grandkids can explore, enjoy, and
thrive on our planet.

Across California, I’ve met so many inspiring people. Hard-working parents
who want to earn a decent living to provide for their family. Students who
attend California’s incredible schools and want to graduate without
crippling debt. Seniors and veterans who want to receive the benefits they
deserve and worked so hard for. Community members who want to clean up the
planet and leave behind clean air and water for future generations.

These are the people I’m running to represent in the United States Senate
— and with your help, I’ll do just that in 46 days.

Please, help me reach as many voters across California as I can before
Election Day. Chip in
$10 or a
meaningful amount to our campaign today.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

Hi friends,
This is Tim Kaine and Jacky Rosen here, and we’re reaching out today about two things that are really important to us – our faith, and our shared fight to continue serving the American people in the Senate in November.
**This email is meaningful to us, and we hope you’ll take a moment to read it.** [**_But in case you’re pressed for time, we’d like to ask if you could split a donation to help power our campaigns in the weeks ahead._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93231381/499796737/-1452846037?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4872-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTY5ZjFlMi03YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=taKdc39l7rVQgmG75ALBaI4Te4GgoPRXZ2FTqpQwKXs=)

We come from different ideological backgrounds – Tim is Catholic, and Jacky is Jewish – but what unites us across our traditions is _our shared belief in justice, compassion, and the importance of serving others._
Faith has always been a guiding force in our lives. For Tim, running a Jesuit mission school in Honduras – teaching teenagers to be carpenters and welders – shaped his work to combat poverty and create just systems in society. And for Jacky, the Jewish concept of tikkun olam – which means to leave the world a better place than we found it – guided her actions as president of her synagogue and her decision to run for public office in the first place.
It’s important to share what grounds us. **Like so many of you, our faith has taught us that we all have a responsibility to look out for our neighbors and to keep fighting against injustice and inequality whenever possible.**
Right now, we’re in a tough fight – not just for our seats in the Senate, but for the values that shape our work every day.
The stakes couldn’t be higher – from safeguarding freedoms like reproductive rights and voting rights, to protecting our democracy from our MAGA opponents, to continuing to build an economy that works fairly for all Americans.
**To accomplish these goals and so many more, we need to come together to hold onto our Democratic majority in the Senate. The good news is that what unites us is _so much more powerful_ than what divides us – so we’ve got a real shot at getting this done. **
**[Today, will you split a donation between our two campaigns so we can continue fighting for our shared values and the people of Virginia and Nevada in the U.S. Senate?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93231383/499796739/-1452846037?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4872-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTY5ZjFlMi03YTc3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=taKdc39l7rVQgmG75ALBaI4Te4GgoPRXZ2FTqpQwKXs=)**

There were a lot of reasons to be excited about last year's election results, Team, but what happened in Mississippi should give us all pause and show us why we need to fight in every state nationwide.
Mississippi has an egregious voting rights record and has the highest level of felony disenfranchisement in the country. A Jim Crow-era constitutional provision enables Mississippi to disenfranchise more than 10% of its total voting-age population and its disenfranchisement of Black voters exceeds 15% .
Mississippi has no early voting opportunities and a narrow set of qualifications for those seeking to vote absentee, meaning that the vast majority of ballots are cast on Election Day. This inaccessibility contributes to the state’s notoriously dismal voter turnout: In this year’s primary election, only 30% of those registered to vote turned out, the lowest rate since 2007.
On Election Day 2023 at least nine polling locations in the state’s most populous county — Hinds County, home of the city of Jackson — ran out of ballots multiple times throughout the day . The fight to extend polling hours became a confusing jumble of legal filings and contradicting orders all as voters waited in line -- and many left entirely due to the lack of ballots .
Also in Hinds County, opponents of voting rights in the state legislature have previously taken aim at Jackson and its over 80% Black population by creating a new court system with an unelected judge in a portion of Jackson and expanding the state-run Capitol Police force’s jurisdiction to cover the entire city rather than just a handful of government buildings.
Mississippi's playbook is clear: Disenfranchise, limit ballot access, obscure legal pathways for justice, rely on Jim Crow laws still on the books, and codify control for decades. Their endgame is power and control , not fairness or freedom.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy or at least a good part of it.

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

| | I’ll be quick – a recent poll showed 54% of voters want to elect someone new, and now: ...Everyone’s talking about our unprecedented shot to unseat a Republican Senator
...Our research shows that if we can reach every undecided voter, I can win

subject: The time for climate action is now

The dangers of climate change are right here on our doorstep, Peter, and the time for action is now. The past few months have been incredibly hot and dangerous. I had to declare emergencies for extreme heat and for wildfires ravaging our beautiful state. High temperatures and incredibly dry wildfire conditions are our new normal in the summer, as practically every year becomes the new hottest year on record. That’s why my administration is serious about taking action to fight climate change and build community resilience. Investing in clean energy, public transportation, electric vehicles, and efficient heating and cooling for new housing will reduce carbon emissions statewide. We’re also working to protect families from the harms of a changing climate, like wildfire smoke and record-breaking heat. It’s essential that we do everything we can to combat climate change and protect our clean air, water, and natural resources. But I can’t take on this challenge alone. In the presumed safe-blue state of New Mexico, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate **Nella Domenici** has the Democrats on their heels.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. name: Neil Parrott
subject: Breaking News: National Endorsement!
body:
Great News! I am honored by the official selection by the National Republican Congressional Committee | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=3052bf6483)

| Below you will find a strong, national endorsement of our campaign.

For months, our team has had boots on the ground, waving signs, walking in parades, and distributing literature with my common-sense message. My wife April and I have canvassed the five-county-wide district many times over, talking with people, listening to their concerns, and working to understand the needs and strengths of each unique community.

YOU have been a big part of our organization through your encouragement, donations, and volunteering. Thank you. Please read today's press release below.
---
|
---
| PRESS RELEASE - September 20, 2024

HAGERSTOWN, MD—Today, Neil Parrott’s campaign announced his selection as a member of the National Republican Congressional Committee's prestigious Young Guns program. This program identifies and supports strong Republican candidates who are running competitive races for Congress.

"Being named to the NRCC Young Guns program is a tremendous honor," said Neil Parrott. "As a problem solver, engineer, and past Delegate, I work to find practical solutions to the challenges we face—from protecting our constitutional rights to creating economic opportunities for families. I am eager to bring common-sense solutions to Washington.

Parrott went on to say that, “With the support of the NRCC and this outstanding program, as a result of recent polling and the voters we are talking with throughout the district, my volunteers and I feel the momentum growing to make positive changes for our country and to bring a practical engineer to DC.”

The NRCC Young Guns program highlights candidates whose campaigns have strength, organization, and the commitment necessary to win tough races and ensure Republican victories nationwide.

To see Parrott’s 30 second TV ad, please go to [https://youtu.be/AZv5cGB77FA](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=d5eeacb1b5&e=5a45ee1154)

Neil Parrott, a devoted husband, father of three, business owner, and engineer, is deeply connected to the community and understands the challenges facing Maryland families. He is running a highly competitive race in Maryland’s 6th District, with recent public polling showing him leading Biden-Harris appointee April Delaney. His inclusion in the Young Guns program underscores the growing momentum and strength of his campaign.

Parrott represented Washington County in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2011 to 2023. The 6th Congressional District includes all of Washington, Allegany, Frederick and Garrett counties, as well as the northern portion of Montgomery County.

| | Georgia’s State Election Board is meeting **today** to pass even more changes to our election rules — brought on by pro-Trump Election Board members. These changes, like giving Georgia local election officials the power to veto Georgians' votes by delaying or refusing to certify election results based on unsubstantiated beliefs, could impact the results of the upcoming election and prevent voters from being heard. At the board's meeting today, they’re considering changing election rules in ways that seem meant to create a fail point in our system. One rule change being considered, put forward by a MAGA election denier, adds unnecessary burdens on our election process, increases the potential for disruption, and increases workloads on overworked poll workers. | Peter- This week, I debunked the notion that Kamala Harris would somehow be a good commander in chief in light of the disastrous foreign policy decisions she has played a role in under this administration. I also spoke to Republicans in Texas about the message we should be carrying to voters on the fence in this election and how to effect change in 2024, and highlighted the large-scale, targeted operation against Hezbollah operatives in Lebanon.
We are now less than 50 days away from arguably the most important election of our generation. While the presidential race is taking up most of the oxygen, just as important is the race for the House of Representatives. If President Trump wins, as he should, but doesn’t have a Republican majority in the House then none of his agenda will be passed into law. If the worst case scenario plays out in the presidential race, then Republicans must use our majority to hold Kamala Harris accountable and roadblock her radical proposals.
We can only hold the House majority if you are willing to donate. It’s just that simple. While my election is safe, there are dozens of close races across the country from New York to California that will determine which party controls the House of Representatives. When you donate to my campaign, that money goes right out the door to support these candidates - commonsense conservative leaders who are running in Democrat states and in districts that Joe Biden won in 2020. I don’t hold onto your resources in some campaign warchest like many politicians; I put it to immediate use.

| Peace through strength has been a guiding principle of American foreign policy, one that demands a strong U.S. military and decisive leadership from the commander in chief.
Since the start of the Biden-Harris Administration, the United States has been losing ground on the world stage. President Biden’s most notable foreign policy failures—the disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan, signaling to Putin that a ‘minor incursion’ into Ukraine might be acceptable, and deterring Israel from finishing off Hamas—have weakened our standing globally. Kamala Harris has been present for every one of those decisions. Additionally, her failure to lead when tasked with solving our border crisis is a glaring example of the lack of strength and decisiveness necessary to protect this country.
The commander in chief must understand the often zero-sum nature of foreign affairs, where advancing America's interests usually comes at the expense of our rivals. Leadership is about preventing crises from spiraling out of control, not pursuing Kamala’s misguided notion of universal "fairness” which leaves our troops in a compromised position against our adversaries.
Kamala Harris simply isn't suited to be the commander in chief, and it's obvious to anyone with common sense.

| The majority of the electorate in this election have already made up their minds. President Trump has a core set of voters who will vote for him no matter what. Kamala Harris has the same thing on her side. The real fight in this election is for that slim share of voters in the middle - the undecideds - who have yet to make up their minds about who they’re going to vote for in not only the presidential race, but up and down the ballot.
So, how do we win those voters to our side?
Elections are fundamentally about persuasion. Elections are not about screaming and yelling in our own bubble, to people who already agree with us. That wins us no new voters. We must go outside our bubble and into moderate or even liberal environments and speak to people who might otherwise not hear from us.
That was my message for activists in Montgomery County, Texas, one of the most conservative areas of the entire country. I had a mission for our Republican activists: go out and persuade the independent and undecided voters to join us. And if you live in a deep red county like Montgomery, where a GOP victory is assured, you can volunteer in a blue county like Harris County. There is always more you can do - donate, volunteer, hand out campaign literature, walk blocks, anything.
And the message to swing voters is simple: by every metric, you were better off under four years of President Trump than you were under Biden-Harris and America is better under conservative leadership at every single level of our government.

The explosions have killed dozens of Hezbollah operatives and injured many more—including Iran’s ambassador to Lebanon. (What was he doing with a Hezbollah device..?)
Hezbollah is blaming Israel for the attacks, of course. Since October 7th, the terrorist group has conducted rocket strikes against Israel in support of Hamas, likely an effort to draw Israeli attention and resources away from Gaza. Of course, Hezbollah has been targeting Israel for decades.
This clever operation against Hezbollah will at least force the group to question their internal security operations and the safety of the communication devices they rely on. It’s a surgical way to respond to their rocket attacks without starting another ground war.

Did you catch Sarah’s email?
#
We wanted to make sure you didn’t miss Sarah’s important email from last weekend about President Biden’s support for our campaign.
[**If you didn’t catch it, continue reading below and then pitch in $5 to help us elect Sarah in 46 days!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240920-1?refcode=em20240920-1-1241&amount=5&refcode2=1241_21716_hZ6gsf&akid=1241%2E21716%2EhZ6gsf)**
\----Forwarded Message----
This week, President Biden shared his heartfelt congratulations on our campaign securing the Democratic nomination for Delaware’s sole seat in Congress!
In a new interview with the _Washington Blade_ , he said:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240920-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240920-1-1241&refcode2=1241_21716_hZ6gsf&akid=1241%2E21716%2EhZ6gsf)
I’m honored to call Delaware’s favorite son — President Joe Biden — a long-time friend. And I couldn’t be more proud to have his support and confidence as we fight to carry forward his legacy of championing working families and equity.
As the first openly transgender state senator, we have already made incredible strides for equality and justice. But there’s more work to do for all of us — and I can’t do it alone. I need your help.
[**Will you join President Biden in supporting this campaign by chipping in $5 or more today to help us continue fighting for Delaware and a brighter future?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240920-1?refcode=em20240920-1-1241&amount=5&refcode2=1241_21716_hZ6gsf&akid=1241%2E21716%2EhZ6gsf) Every donation helps power this campaign as we quickly approach the General Election.

Thank you for standing with me and joining us in this important fight for progress!
Sarah McBride

Team,
Last week, Donald Trump got onto the presidential debate stage and spread dangerous lies about our country.
He claimed that Aurora, Colorado, is under siege by a gang of migrants.
He accused Haitian immigrants in Springfield, Ohio, of eating cats and dogs.
And he refused to admit that he lost the 2020 election.
It’s no surprise that Donald Trump would use the national stage to spread lies. After all, it’s what he’s always done.
But these lies have serious real-world consequences.
Trump’s refusal to acknowledge the results of the 2020 election resulted in the January 6th insurrection — and continues to threaten our democratic principles today.
And since the debate, multiple elementary schools in Springfield have been evacuated because of bomb threats.
Trump’s racist and hateful lies are putting children’s lives and the future of our democracy at risk.
In November, we have a chance to reject their extremist agenda.

body:
Peter,

Early voting starts today! If you haven’t already checked your registration status and polling place location or decided when to cast your vote, now is the time to make a plan.

FIND MY POLLING PLACE at https://www.sos.mn.gov/elections-voting/

This will be one of the most consequential elections of our lives. Donald Trump, JD Vance, and MAGA Republicans up and down the ballot want to undermine our democracy and impose their dangerous Project 2025 agenda on our nation. If Minnesota turns red for the first time since 1972, right-wing extremists will weaken voting rights, eliminate reproductive freedom, and make it harder for people to live with dignity, safety, and respect.

Despite Trump’s extreme beliefs and erratic behavior, this race is incredibly close. Recent polls suggest Vice President Kamala Harris has a small lead in Minnesota, but some indicate that her margin is shrinking.

So, Peter, here’s the bottom line: tight races come down to turnout. That’s why it’s so important for all of us to get to the polls and encourage others to participate.

In 2020, Minnesota led the nation in voter turnout, with 79.96 percent of eligible voters participating. This year, our state has another chance to lead the nation and defeat Trump.

Let’s stay at the forefront of progress and elect leaders like Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz. Exercise your right to vote and encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same.

Thank you,

Team Keith

Friends, As many of you may be aware, a recent poll conducted by [Emerson College ](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=b07be0816d6348b3ae8e8dc369bd97e7&_e=aWGWP39TEb__BquLfAFpfY_x4JkQBq-xqZpFXpYCWL5kB7qL2URsC0PteVZoGc64RSj2TTvZ-A1h6fdZGve2RCtCVtX63Q6HiY-riIsIF2KhQkkZra9m4_YB0NhY9kCFmRfWJbKmUKYRCvGCunCD_bx29x2z8xAhPj8FjPdzWhAaAho9rPsFs9ezpAvl1wZ0CcEStkGn3sadFzM0PUOQW0yoso5tyKMBTjIYPGcaNe2mDITrm5mly08gzE8d1hbSM_tBrvyYpqA2n26PpvdRzg%3D%3D)shows that Hoosiers are aligning with our Republican values and principles, giving us a strong foundation as we head into this critical election. The support we’re seeing is not just a reflection of our hard work, but of our commitment to serving the people of Indiana with integrity and conservative leadership.

However, we cannot take this support for granted. The poll is encouraging, but it’s only a snapshot in time. We must stay focused on the task at hand, especially when it comes to electing Republicans across the state, up and down the ballot. Every seat matters, and our efforts at the local level will be key to securing these victories.

We need to continue knocking on doors, making phone calls, and engaging voters to ensure that our message is heard in every corner of Indiana. This is not the time to slow down—it's the time to step up. Together, we can ensure our candidates have the resources, energy, and support to win in November.

Thank you for all that you do, and let’s keep up the momentum to secure a Republican victory in 2024! Thank you all for what you do!

_**Mike Braun’s Education Plan to Put Hoosier Kids and Parents First**_
---
---
Below are highlights from the Freedom and Opportunity Agenda - Education Plan to Put Hoosier Kids and Parents First.
---
**1) Universal School Choice for Every Hoosier Family**
* Over 50% of Indiana's budget is spent on K-12 education. It is time that those dollars are used to make our public and private schools the best in the nation.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** put parents in the driver’s seat by supporting and expanding Indiana’s school choice programs, which allow Hoosier families to choose the school that best fits their children’s educational needs, regardless of their income, race, or ZIP code.

**2) Boost Teacher Pay and Improve Benefits**
* Mike Braun knows from running a business how to take care of employees. Just like the private sector, concrete steps need to be taken to enhance teacher pay and benefits.

* **Mike Braun's plan will **overhaul public teacher pay by increasing base salary, ensuring teachers have access to professional benefits, and improved health insurance options.

**3) Build a Strong Teacher Pipeline **
* Indiana is contending with teacher shortages while trying to recruit and retain high-quality teachers.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** expand Indiana’s teacher pipeline by making it easier for professionals to switch careers into teaching, cutting red tape for teachers who move to Indiana, leveraging data to recruit teachers in high-need content areas and school districts, and partnering with successful Educator Preparation Programs.

**4) Prioritize School Safety**
* School safety in Indiana is fragmented across multiple agencies, leading to potential gaps and inefficiencies in protecting our students.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** establish the Office of School Safety ensuring every Hoosier student benefits from the highest standards of school safety. Bolster the Secured School Safety Grant Program and implement cyber safety training for students.

**5) Improve Quality and Raise Academic Standards**
* The State should continue to invest in improving educational outcomes for students by focusing on math and reading cognition, instituting clear accountability outcomes for students, and removing distractions from the classroom.

* **Mike Braun's plan will **provide parents with easy-to-understand accountability scores for their schools. Ensure state dollars are dedicated to student achievement and support using high quality, evidence-based instruction and are not focused on divisive social issues like Critical Race Theory.

**6) Prepare Students for Success Beyond High School**
* Approximately half of Hoosiers that graduate high school go to college, the other half of students need to be prepared for success in the workforce or military.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** allow every parent and student the opportunity to define success for their circumstance. Reward schools for student success, be it enrolling in higher education, engaging in an apprenticeship program, joining the military, or starting their careers.

**7) Put Kids First by Protecting Parental Rights **
* The rights of Hoosier parents to participate in their children’s education, safeguard their wellbeing, and protect them from divisive ideologies should never be in doubt.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** safeguard parents' roles as the primary advocates for their child’s wellbeing and the decision makers in their children’s lives. Ensure parents are never surprised at what is being taught in the classroom or disconnected from conversations with their child about their physical or mental health.

---
_**Mike Braun issued the following statement upon releasing his Education Plan For Indiana:**_
_"As a father and former school board member, I know parents are the primary stakeholders in their kids’ education. My future-focused education plan puts Hoosier kids and parents first, raises teacher pay and incentive, ensures that our kids are safe, and puts Indiana schools on the path to become the best in the nation" - Mike Braun_

Tammy Baldwin here with an important update on my campaign: A new poll from Emerson College shows me locked in a statistical tie with my right-wing opponent, Eric Hovde, in Wisconsin's Senate race. Hovde and his right-wing allies have flooded Wisconsin with tens of millions worth of campaign ads to attack my record and dispel the fact that he's an out-of-state, out-of-touch megamillionaire who doesn't know or live our Wisconsin values. As they've poured eye-popping sums of money into this race, Eric Hovde has surged in the polls — to the point where this is now a tied race. We need to launch new ads now to fight back against these attacks and expose Hovde's extreme views. ** Every Tool in the GOTV Toolbox
------------------------------------------------------------

This includes absentee voting. While many Republicans are skeptical about voting by mail, we should dislike something even more: missing the opportunity to cast our vote!

Life happens, and there are valid reasons why some may need to vote by mail—whether due to travel, illness, or unforeseen circumstances. It’s time to put those concerns aside and embrace every possible method to maximize Republican turnout, ensuring a solid Republican voice, ‘Trump,’ any hesitation about how the vote is cast (see what I did there?).

Let’s approach this election with a “no voter left behind” mentality. Every Republican vote matters, and we need to use every tool at our disposal—whether in-person early voting, absentee ballots, or Election Day turnout—to ensure our collective voice is heard loud and clear. The stakes are too high to leave any stone unturned or any vote on the table.

So let’s unite in our commitment to victory, put aside any personal hesitations, and ensure that every Republican gets their vote in—no matter how it’s cast. It’s about participation, about standing up for our values, and making sure the future we envision is built on the strength of every Republican voter.

Together, let’s make sure that every Republican voice is counted!

With 46 days to go until Election Day, we’re working like there’s no tomorrow to defeat the fossil fuel giants in November (who needs sleep when our planet’s future is on the line, right?) While the media is busy covering the big, flashy races, we’re laser-focused on the ones that too often get overlooked — **state legislative races.** This is where much of the real fight for our climate future is happening. **[Click here to chip in any amount today and help us secure victories in these critical down-ballot races.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93243581/499824126/2105508926?refcode=ea.09504cc2-8d77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.09504cc2-8d77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NTA0Y2MyLThkNzctZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=H-ZVb94sO61F7CCkk1JUsF7lvNaBG4Ga44mnvEr3M-Q=)** So far, we’ve made targeted endorsements in **California, Texas, Colorado, Arizona, Michigan, Oregon,** and **Pennsylvania** — in crucial districts where our efforts can make a strategic impact. And with your support, we can secure major climate victories in these down-ballot battles: [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93243582/499824127/2105508926?refcode=ea.09504cc2-8d77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.09504cc2-8d77-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NTA0Y2MyLThkNzctZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=H-ZVb94sO61F7CCkk1JUsF7lvNaBG4Ga44mnvEr3M-Q=) This map shows where we’re in the fight to elect climate champions. Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, JanePAC is making sure these pivotal state elections get the attention — and the investment — _they deserve._
1. In **California,** we’re going after oily politicians and incumbents who are too cozy with fossil fuel interests. Our strategy is already paying off — we scored big wins in the primary, putting climate champions on the ballot this November.

2. In **Arizona,** we pulled off an incredible clean sweep in the primary! All 11 of our JanePAC-endorsed candidates are on the November ballot with a historic chance to flip the state legislature to a pro-climate majority. The stakes couldn’t be higher — Arizona is already feeling the brunt of the climate crisis, and these races could decide the state’s future.

3. In **Michigan,** where razor-thin majorities in both chambers make every race a nail-biter, we’ve endorsed climate champions who are ready to defend and expand Michigan’s progress on clean energy and environmental justice.

4. In **Pennsylvania,** a gridlocked legislature is stalling critical climate action. We're supporting candidates who can flip key seats, break the deadlock, and transform one of the nation's largest fossil fuel producers into a clean energy pioneer.

5. In **Colorado,** holding key seats in the State House is crucial to sustaining the state's climate leadership. Our endorsed climate champion is committed to protecting Colorado's progress on clean energy and safeguarding its natural beauty from fossil fuel exploitation.

6. In **Texas,** we made history when our endorsed candidate, Molly Cook, won the special election for District 15, making her the _first_ openly LGBTQ+ member to serve in the Texas State Senate! Molly is on the ballot again in November to serve out a full term.

7. In **Oregon,** we endorsed two climate champions for the State Senate who are committed to prioritizing climate policy at the state level. With Oregon's rich natural resources and vulnerability to climate-related disasters like wildfires, the state legislature plays a crucial role in shaping policies that protect both the environment and public health for future generations.

_...And we have more coming soon. Stay tuned 👀_ Here’s the truth: We couldn’t do this without you. Grassroots supporters like you have powered this movement. As I said on [_Morning in America_](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=5ed8a727505a44158b2fc20c0cb8986b&_e=yzC6x2UU5ptnBK5EKCIrHXKlTUyk4Q1BnLM9yFa0uk78UdzRPf4pCNykeNLgPCMOL6M5egyWMa82eEWXGTUfLMYLOmAdhNEKLNTZAQsOtxXwQtLNrE2X2_b00ALeSVwLNqYaVmCsDS4DXzzIUaSqX5aR4zJ22njKRl6Atac73J3FoFYIRrCSPdO4zWuX8r-DqCYdJ38tozw4T6S5TAE152JCbx32G60abTOIh0vg53ms1IzUyMxWLc4H8D3Xg0vN65eFMI8dRXtLk9JkTa5tbRcobY7TNkfjlLcXwGcetZbBdYmOOLGQqilSVxNFFz1DNa1z0uQQA7Oyt-GXEIV81hxVsuFufZMpeAzOXsbLZ5M%3D), this isn’t an isolated problem in the Secret Service—it’s a systemic issue across the board. Dear Fellow Floridians, I’m writing to you today to sound the alarm on Amendment 3, a radical marijuana legalization ballot measure that puts Florida kids at risk. This amendment would not just legalize recreational marijuana across our state. It’s so much worse than that. **Amendment 3 would override local rules protecting our public spaces, normalizing open marijuana use around our children.**
---
[**PROTECT OUR CHILDREN: DONATE HERE**](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/u/click?_t=bc9491309104472aae4991b59e968283&_m=b1e64fe7fabb4f7da36f136c4131f3aa&_e=TPNT1q0SehW0fNVq5S7JFptxcX6fS1KPlaPE6CZsB6qPitckyjwA3OxsXrqceGYFivPcVi81z6G1GWCkwCaZTH1vHS2EDpIZpnJFBzOtmaXY_o2w4R6B_ZKbxLRwQNZF3y8jUgGCPAHCTRuO5gDn6sZTDla8Z7MvQcXGTR65xAWVtp0aaxrj3on9Q1FUCwSQZoPqgEW6XQtxZUTWECTEq2DjsHoGzzeg8RU74TvAproTmEzqpkhofKgW_c7g-ePNtbBvNyWJ_tQlL-ua5VDpTmrAfXglfsa1Vam0iAWF9_1zEwtyOpDrqDKXCCSwJtMvhSofMahDlPtzmM4sxbs21RPkxna69s_j6rwVrIAk302EvQ9OVcqXiunxwShT9nu9OhrXI-Tuc8HgSCtrQ2nlAQ%3D%3D)
---
With no restrictions on where marijuana can be consumed, its presence would become commonplace in our parks, beaches, and even near schools. Our kids would be exposed to it everywhere they went. And so much marijuana is now packaged as kid-appealing gummies that it’s even more insidious. If you think this won't lead to increased accidental exposure among our children, it's important to note that it's already happening. Across the nation, there have been distressing incidents where children have mistakenly ingested marijuana - even here in Florida... Just this March, in Port St. Lucie, ten students at Oak Hammock K-8 were hospitalized after consuming THC-infused gummies given to them during school, mistaking them for regular candy.

| Peter,

My parents came here to seek a better life for their family, just like so many others. As one of seven children and a first-generation American, I was raised on the values of hard work and resilience–lessons that have shaped every step of my journey.

**As a labor attorney, I fought for workers who had been exploited and mistreated–people who were doing everything they could to provide for their families yet still struggling to make ends meet. But I knew more needed to be done.**

That’s why I followed my sister’s footsteps and ran for Congress!

**Since I was elected, I’ve fought for fair wages, affordable healthcare and housing, protecting Social Security and Medicare, reforming our tax code, and supporting small businesses–all with the goal of improving life for hardworking families like mine.**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. Josh Stein is the clear choice to be North Carolina’s next governor, and I am so proud to support him.
#

Friends -
My team and I at GIFFORDS PAC have been proud to endorse Josh Stein in his bid for governor of North Carolina.
**If you already know that you’d like to chip in to support Josh, please use this link to make a split contribution between GIFFORDS PAC and Josh Stein’s campaign for governor.**
[**https://go.giffords.org/go/Giffords-Stein**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24-stein.YLiXpv&refcode=em240920-1-60&t=1&akid=8998%2E3935704%2EPK3I1a)
Josh Stein is running against Mark Robinson, who represents the most extreme, right-wing faction of the Republican party. Currently, Robinson is a board member of the NRA — so it’s no surprise that they’re spending money in North Carolina to attack Josh.
It’s clear that Mark Robinson would put gun lobby profits over North Carolinians’ safety if he were elected governor. But in addition to his deep NRA ties, Robinson has made downright cruel comments in the wake of mass shootings in this country.
After the 2018 shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, FL, Robinson made Facebook posts mocking the student survivors. He called them “spoiled” and “angry” for demanding commonsense gun safety reform after 17 of their classmates and teachers were shot and killed at school. In 2022, he spoke at the NRA convention in Houston just three days after 19 children and two teachers were shot and killed at Robb Elementary.
**We should all be outraged by Mark Robinson’s behavior. It is unacceptable, and North Carolinians deserve so much better.**
While Mark Robinson would spend his tenure as governor in the gun lobby’s pocket, we can be sure that Josh Stein will be a gun safety champion as North Carolina’s next governor. During his time as attorney general, Josh Stein has proposed substantive solutions to curb the threat of gun violence. As governor, he would fight for universal background checks on all gun sales; implement a statewide extreme risk law, raise the age requirement for buying military-grade weapons to 21, and better equip schools with staff such as counselors, social workers, and nurses to help kids and lower the risk of violence.
[**Josh Stein is the clear choice to be North Carolina’s next governor, and I am so proud to support him. So please, will you make a split contribution—of $5 or more—between GIFFORDS PAC and Josh Stein to help make sure he defeats Mark Robinson this November?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24-stein.YLiXpv&refcode=em240920-1-60&t=2&akid=8998%2E3935704%2EPK3I1a)

name: Wes Moore
subject: What we’ve been able to accomplish
body:
Friend,

I am proud of what we’ve been able to accomplish in the last two years.

When I ran for Governor in the first place, I ran to make everyday life easier for Maryland families. Seeing my mom raise our family on her own after my dad’s passing, and now raising Mia and James here with Dawn, I know first-hand just how hard families in this state work to get by — and that’s the reason I decided to run for Governor in the first place.

In our last almost two years in office, I’m proud to say we’ve shown that Maryland can do big things for families in our state:

→ We passed the Fair Wage Act, raising the minimum wage and creating an economic cushion for over 150,000 Maryland families .
→ We passed housing legislation to expand affordable housing in our state.
→ We created programs to end child poverty that will lift over 37,000 Maryland children to the next rung of the economic ladder.
→ We signed gun safety laws to protect our communities from gun violence and created the first-ever gun violence prevention center.
→ We just launched the second cohort of Maryland’s Corps and Service Year option. This first-in-the-country program offers a paid year of service for high school graduates.

If you’re ready to join the fight for a stronger Maryland, add a contribution today to support our efforts. With your support, I can keep working to lighten burdens and create opportunity for all Marylanders and their families. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240920-1?refcode=em20240920-1]

Contribute » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240920-1?refcode=em20240920-1]

Thank you for being a part of this team.

Elevate,
Wes

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Student loans and the CFPB
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I’ve been working for years to hold Navient’s feet to the fire.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2348%2E4032634%2ErjTWRm)
---
The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau just announced that Navient, which was once the biggest student loan servicer in America, will have to pay $100 million in relief to borrowers they harmed — on top of a $20 million fine — and will be barred from federal student loan servicing. I’ve been working for years to hold Navient’s feet to the fire for their appalling abuses of student loan borrowers, including...
* Steering people into more expensive repayment options, making it harder for them to pay back their loans
* Throwing roadblocks in the way of student debt cancellation for borrowers who attended fraudulent for-profit schools
* Failing to report borrower complaints — which maybe wasn’t a surprise, because for years they ranked dead last in borrower satisfaction according to surveys from the Department of Education

**The CFPB's actions are an example of the CFPB doing what it does best: holding cheaters accountable and putting money back in the pockets of people who got hurt.** All together, the CFPB has delivered over $20 billion in relief. That’s over 20 billion reasons why it was worth fighting uphill all the way to create this agency dedicated to looking out for consumers. And that’s over 20 billion reasons why we need to keep fighting back as the CFPB’s opponents keep trying to block this agency from doing its job. While I continue working to hold student loan servicers accountable for mistreating borrowers, I’ll keep working alongside the Biden-Harris administration to cancel more student debt — on top of the nearly $170 billion in relief they’ve delivered to over 4.7 million borrowers. And I won’t stop working to put higher education within reach for all. Everyone who wants to should be able to continue their education after high school even if they don’t come from a family that can write a big tuition check. I take on these fights so we can build a future not just for some of our kids but for all of our kids. And we’re able to win these fights because grassroots donors power our grassroots movement. [**If it makes sense for you right now, will you pitch in $28 or any amount to our re-election campaign and help make more change that makes a real difference in working people’s lives?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2696?amount=28&t=8&akid=2348%2E4032634%2ErjTWRm)

subject: We need to spread the success to other states
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Great News! After receiving thousands of petitions, Governor Newsom signed AB 2655 and AB 2839 to ban deepfakes of candidates, elected officials, and elections officials in political advertising or other election communications that are reasonably likely to harm the reputation of candidates or undermine confidence in the outcome of the election for 120 days before an election or 60 days after.
But this is just a stepping stone -- we need to take California's success and make it a reality in other states . That means we need everyone's help to send messages to their governors too.
Add your name to demand your state bans AI deepfakes in our elections >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092024_3&amount=25]
Folks, The danger is on the horizon:
Fake video, images, and audio — so-called “deepfakes” created by artificial intelligence (AI) — are becoming a major problem for elections around the world.
Just last month, Elon Musk shared a deepfake video of Kamala Harris in which a hyper-realistic but fake version of the Vice President degrades herself and calls herself a “deep state puppet.” Sadly, it was viewed more than 150 million times in a single week.

Saludos — Happy Hispanic Heritage Month! I’m incredibly proud to represent New Mexico’s largest Hispanic District in Congress. In New Mexico, we are blessed with a rich and diverse tapestry of history, culture and tradition that comes to life in the people and landscapes we call home. Many important parts of Hispanic history—as well as our nation’s history—have been written here against the backdrop of our public lands and the jagged, sun-kissed peaks of the Organ Mountains. This month, and every month, we honor those who came before us — and celebrate the continuation of our traditions and culture now in the 21st century. As a first-generation Mexican-American who grew up on both sides of the border, I know how important it is that our stories are told in Congress, and I’m proud to help lead the Congressional Hispanic Caucus. But here’s the thing: my time in Congress could be cut short. I only flipped this seat blue in 2022 with 50.3% of the vote, and MAGA Republicans are throwing every attack my way to unseat me this November. Many important parts of Hispanic history—as well as our nation’s history—have been written here against the backdrop of our public lands and the jagged, sun-kissed peaks of the Organ Mountains. subject: It’s time to build homes designed for people, not profit.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The United States faces a housing crisis of epic proportions, with too
many working people unable to afford a roof over their heads.

While the federal government provides some support to single-family
homeowners, it’s not enough — most financial support goes to large,
corporate landlords and for-profit developers who are building homes for
profit instead of people. And the public housing that does exist in our
communities is often neglected or in poor condition that threatens the
health and safety of its residents.

As Justice Democrats Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Sen. Tina Smith
explain in their latest New York Times essay, “The result is a housing
market where corporate landlords make record profits while half of
America’s 44 million renters struggle to pay rent. For a generation of
young people, the idea of home has become loaded with anxiety; too many
know they can’t find an affordable, stable place to rent, let alone buy.”

To finally combat this, AOC and Tina just unveiled a historic new bill for
social housing called the Homes Act, which would establish a new,
federally backed development authority to finance and build homes in big
cities and small towns across America using union labor.

It would then turn the management of those residences over to entities
that agree to manage them for permanent affordability, such as public and
tribal housing authorities, cooperatives, tenant unions, community land
trusts, nonprofits, and local governments. Under this plan:

* Rent would be capped at 25% of a household’s adjusted gross income;
* Homes would be built and set aside for lower-income families in
mixed-income buildings and communities;
* Every home would be built to modern and efficient standards to ensure
health and safety while cutting utility costs for residents.

This is the bold solution we need to address one of the biggest problems
facing working people across our country, but it’s going to require strong
public pressure to push Congress to support it.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240920_homes_act/?source=em20240920-36007&akid=36007%2E1203867%2EITdTNa ]Will you add your name to show your support for AOC’s Homes Act right
now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240920_homes_act/?source=em20240920-36007&akid=36007%2E1203867%2EITdTNa ]Add Your Name

This is a perfect example of why we need more working-class, progressive
leaders like AOC in Congress with the lived experience and commitment to
fight for the policies that put working people, not profits, first. Let’s
do everything we can to support her bill and make it a reality!

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Friend, **As activist Grace Lee Boggs taught us, transformative change doesn’t start in the halls of Congress or the White House: It happens in the streets when the people demand it.** Together, we have marched on critical issues impacting our communities, from Black Lives Matter to immigrants’ rights to climate justice to reproductive health. It is our First Amendment right to raise our voices in protest. **And yet, Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel has chosen to press criminal charges against 11 pro-ceasefire protesters from this past spring’s University of Michigan protests** , an attack on students that flies in the face of our state and country’s Constitutions**.** Additional reporting indicates that the Detroit Police Department has been surveilling dozens of anti-genocide protesters in violation of their civil rights. Remember, Attorney General Nessel failed to pursue prosecutions against those responsible for the Flint water crisis that poisoned the Flint community. And yet, she has filed charges of “trespassing” against students who were speaking truth to power on their own university campus. **Instead of getting justice or criminal charges in the Flint water crisis, the Attorney General has chosen to use the power of her office to silence the First Amendment rights of pro-ceasefire protesters.** [**Join me in demanding Attorney General Dana Nessel immediately drop the charges against pro-ceasefire student protesters, which are in violation of their First Amendment right. Add your name now >>**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38C5j3Pr0hPf84egRS83i1p9JheM8hdJlaBenZf6LhCGGP0IX7h7pOzWpiGwQn2FD5e6Y9S7E5DApFN5fSWCJAYbzc__8zBb50yiDCiuXXvkhWDgTEIdOA0pI3QtaOzb5PAFNT4ibFV-3nQzH2qG8tO4HnR41H_t4PxIG_NL9JusphmFdCctoA4Tp17Eo3dixm81GgQiFkZVj9bo1m6839FvnL_5m5y2_Dt-UEd6Mh2asGEqXpy9rmGCdbyUEGAPskFL0Jlr-CNKPMcBlSAF2iEFGfN-6DDImpqRkxGUaC8ey5PoorySU8glH-NQlBzP0gBStUoj9aAwd3cBdkL2fBU7S2xlRfXMrUslkZnKpdc3w4on_cDNQ8BZJBocE0DwkuzZaF1qCt2MdIODyhcqO5PYjvipIbQRPsxfSaZh1r6ur0aEBlsTxcgZ3AmBPmosmz4FEjYX2_UVeISE5zUepxZ/49x/LgP_i9U9QV2ziT6j2B0Jlw/h1/h001.n-2gOkTG1vM4QK2idraQ0Hh25iBG7TzYMq4siPfO3YY) | [TAKE ACTION](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38C5j3Pr0hPf84egRS83i1p9JheM8hdJlaBenZf6LhCGGP0IX7h7pOzWpiGwQn2FD5e6Y9S7E5DApFN5fSWCJAYbzc__8zBb50yiDCiuXXvkjcDnJOos5KqX6NOxMfVKa4wEUGDvJmNDKnd_tb57CwlgBPFaEUBHMfNLaJqqz7JQ7eWA6Spmv-ifMfY1sTMdNmgrKr6wKEnfbUsznd0YfZJTCqG6fi39OWEkFL3CwAFImGStarsssumScaw97lREmJZTBvPTuNfLaZqCXS5ixyQzReNM_9EMxdrYvkSvZ-PIsIy_mmfD47AOrDjqkFek1cvcaV-V2s9Z0wm_gSghr08dgAMB_pQbaUWioctyjNA8PXtO5FCyx5QAHNuCmsG5oXdsVANuxa1KbG2uQNJCgO5F5d3zId0pEqrubTfqjlT96puASrK047ReB0VXOL3W90nMuLUlwHQm5ZujGoVLGAZ/49x/LgP_i9U9QV2ziT6j2B0Jlw/h2/h001.3vlD4Aroj74LRkR3Tw_n17ywmvR84zRTe4vqFTsI9cQ)

Earlier this year I had the opportunity to visit the University of Michigan’s Gaza solidarity encampment on the Diag, an area of campus historically used for student protests. That’s where students held their protests this spring and again last month at a back-to-campus event.
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38C5j3Pr0hPf84egRS83i1p9JheM8hdJlaBenZf6LhCGGP0IX7h7pOzWpiGwQn2FD5e6Y9S7E5DApFN5fSWCJAYbzc__8zBb50yiDCiuXXvkgt669yBHoFaBJICUu1E5FvBXilrbEg67YCg4MIL5CpVJdVsGEp15CPhKdY3nItHHMzmZORRVFFc9afVjyai8mwf4lgJ-1ntXr5HPH5V1TjLVpfWstxMt1Z5ScppMKN04FRvvkckytOqBfH7fMIOonPy7qNimNXbjK_6o7EEUABq2nWo16AOjiHBBDqkm_8StMrbcc1mvMTp2nvbDLkVTWizHgGa6H-LUyyFimceZiEcIw1YvQoZ7EnpB5MsAaNQt_wIz1242QUEKfEaGc4mQnAdDra7zPff5ILOL5rkQvhh6nFIsDymrnk9JSLC-awxdQ0mXcOIqHhr3blCqZsJ_p1wRRUMRXWbYfOG85ThdSzu/49x/LgP_i9U9QV2ziT6j2B0Jlw/h3/h001.ZkNRng_mLPVPk2skNqKD6uUJI7-FGtGDPMl0uNJa14s)
_Photo Credit: Adam J. Dewey_
As the ACLU of Michigan wrote in response to Attorney General Nessel’s shameful attack on students, “ _The right to protest peacefully is a cornerstone of our nation’s democracy.”_ It’s also a fundamental constitutional right as part of our free speech protections in the First Amendment, and it’s essential to creating social change.
**We will not stop working to protect the rights of student protesters who were speaking truth to power in an effort to save lives.**
[**Add your name to demand Attorney General Nessel drop the charges against pro-ceasefire protesters now.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38C5j3Pr0hPf84egRS83i1p9JheM8hdJlaBenZf6LhCGGP0IX7h7pOzWpiGwQn2FD5e6Y9S7E5DApFN5fSWCJAYbzc__8zBb50yiDCiuXXvksoK77-Vu3UCovr57_myIRygIeoHRR24v_IcS-sHWc08fOnP66kOfdlX-IowIp2mEFVVflkaHWaI0t65X-oWZmz-8BqLLBGz7hb85hWK94i5scT4UIG_ThQC5srneMBeiOiuzqhL-im910hEqvpa_VO4hrEl4BBT0NbQL4mXYRbOUcilhgdfLeVbeI-gWi7lEC_DVoHW_HTNnK3d7y5ixf4UZRWeVWNRUCN6diIo9QHNiIULWwt1JlWbC0td2c02k92qmGiD9qVA_B9iB80Ea2P2PqB_H8nC6X7qbcNgvokbp6dcrd0y3s62fDdK5dwwy48VCpxsjqggGz8Og64i0dR8jEmWJ6frCs9JYZVUcdKB/49x/LgP_i9U9QV2ziT6j2B0Jlw/h4/h001.jQj-Pzh3N0QPfsANyyxQZK8KUHArYRcmJfWZ6jhr8TI)

In solidarity,
Rashida

clean_body: I visited the University of Michigan’s Gaza solidarity encampment and I will continue to support students. | | | Friend, As activist Grace Lee Boggs taught us, transformative change doesn’t start in the halls of Congress or the White House: It happens in the streets when the people demand it. Together, we have marched on critical issues impacting our communities, from Black Lives Matter to immigrants’ rights to climate justice to reproductive health. It is our First Amendment right to raise our voices in protest. And yet, Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel has chosen to press criminal charges against 11 pro-ceasefire protesters from this past spring’s University of Michigan protests , an attack on students that flies in the face of our state and country’s Constitutions. Additional reporting indicates that the Detroit Police Department has been surveilling dozens of anti-genocide protesters in violation of their civil rights. Remember, Attorney General Nessel failed to pursue prosecutions against those responsible for the Flint water crisis that poisoned the Flint community. And yet, she has filed charges of “trespassing” against students who were speaking truth to power on their own university campus. Instead of getting justice or criminal charges in the Flint water crisis, the Attorney General has chosen to use the power of her office to silence the First Amendment rights of pro-ceasefire protesters. | Earlier this year I had the opportunity to visit the University of Michigan’s Gaza solidarity encampment on the Diag, an area of campus historically used for student protests. That’s where students held their protests this spring and again last month at a back-to-campus event. Photo Credit: Adam J. Dewey As the ACLU of Michigan wrote in response to Attorney General Nessel’s shameful attack on students, “ The right to protest peacefully is a cornerstone of our nation’s democracy.” It’s also a fundamental constitutional right as part of our free speech protections in the First Amendment, and it’s essential to creating social change. We will not stop working to protect the rights of student protesters who were speaking truth to power in an effort to save lives. I promise to continue defending our rights and saving lives at home and abroad. Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b5ba0c91bee24795a9f6c6dbcbacbd75&_e=6WgSx2E1JrPPO-4P6L6cJ_V6pLUgq92QSX6HIznnIs5QjC-9qeqEkPCy9WgW6Lpv2AAWy14gv5vmEdVgqFemDjeQN3Ri7bYZclF6_3oyDQuhsLEvBKXlDLDinSfl2LGankoCJgOaZX0HM0dy7By5zkxQdz0ZBqYZUPHqvA5h-Zz0d4sX1wjC058U48BIqpPQR-8knc0yvvXo5552Fqp8Lvn_u3bBGjwTzq66Y_iJ9n0qxYlOejGGg_UvPmap2AJkajFjjdnKeh8aShjsUKsGodxDZvKgrBb41ij6-M9oHWIcrNJh0Y3kjgzo4NFsagwIvL10pldMT-ScSLtdPpQl5TUn65io5IqACERxaqfNabf7ZQAh-l26vGUjFb2MIAUEOptf3ePcd8_LZyi3tI4TlZ4fHrbQZc-rSB2O76TiItg%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM2_V1_S1&t=4&akid=7631%2E5257348%2ELqzcYM)
_Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah._
I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.
Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.
Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask — **[will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to my campaign?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=sept2024_abs_em.a1Ivk6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=7631%2E5257348%2ELqzcYM)**
I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there that my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
The above photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all).
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.
In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: **_What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God._**
These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.
**And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.**
That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.
**[If these priorities resonate with you, I’m asking for your help to continue that work by chipping in $18 or another meaningful amount to my campaign.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/3987?c0=sept2024_abs_em.G22G36&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240920_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=7631%2E5257348%2ELqzcYM)**

clean_body: I wanted to make sure you heard this directly from me. | = Peter — I wanted to make sure you heard this directly from me: On Tuesday, we launched our Swing State Support Fund , and today is the last day to help hit our $150,000 goal and support Democratic pro-choice women running up and down the ballot in battleground states. = | = Over the past few weeks, I've spent a lot of time in battleground states with our phenomenal candidates, and what I'm seeing on the ground is nothing short of remarkable. During my stop in Grand Rapids, Michigan, I was blown away by the incredible energy of a crowd eager to elect Rep. Elissa Slotkin to the U.S. Senate. In Nevada, I had a great conversation with Sen. Jacky Rosen and local pro-choice leaders about making abortion rights a central issue in this election. Sen. Tammy Baldwin and I discussed the stakes of the upcoming elections in Wisconsin — and why it's absolutely paramount that we continue to elect Democratic pro-choice women in the Badger State. It's clear from my travels through the swing states that our pro-choice message is resonating with voters. But anti-choice Republicans are spending millions of dollars in these states, and the polls are so close that we can't afford to fall behind — not even a little. * **TOP NEWS**

**" A fire that burned for 4 days after Texas pipeline explosion has finally gone out,"** AP's**Juan A. Lozano** -- "A pipeline fire that burned in a Houston suburb for four days finally went out Thursday as authorities announced a criminal investigation into the blaze that had roared into a towering flame, forcing neighborhoods to evacuate and melting parts of nearby cars.

Before the fire fully stopped Thursday evening, officials announced that human remains were found in an SUV that had been next to the flame since the explosion happened Monday. Investigators say the fire began after the driver of that car went through a fence alongside a Walmart parking lot and struck an above-ground valve.

Officials in Deer Park, where the explosion occurred, described the crash as an accident, and said police and local FBI agents have not found evidence of a coordinated or terrorist attack.

"This has developed into a criminal investigation and will be actively ongoing until more information is available," the city said in a statement late Thursday.

As authorities worked to identify who had driven the vehicle, residents who were forced to flee the towering blaze returned to assess the damage on Thursday. They found mailboxes and vehicles partially melted by the intense heat, a neighborhood park charred and destroyed and fences burned to the ground.

"Devastated, upset, scared. We don't know what we're going to do now," said **Diane Hutto** , 51, after finding her home severely damaged by water that firefighters poured on it to keep it from catching fire. Hutto's home is located only a few hundred feet from the pipeline.

Before the fire went out, its reduced size meant police finally had access to the area around the pipeline. Investigators removed the white SUV and towed it away Thursday morning.

While medical examiners with Harris County were processing the vehicle, they recovered and removed human remains found inside, Deer Park officials said in a statement.
Officials say the underground pipeline, which runs under high-voltage power lines in a grassy corridor between the Walmart and a residential neighborhood, was damaged when the SUV driver left the store's parking lot, entered the wide grassy area and went through a fence surrounding the valve equipment.

But authorities have offered few details on what caused the vehicle to crash through the fence and hit the pipeline valve.

Energy Transfer, the Dallas-based company that owns the pipeline, on Wednesday called it an accident. Deer Park officials said preliminary investigations by police and FBI agents found no evidence of a terrorist attack.

The pipeline is a 20-inch-wide conduit that runs for miles through the Houston area. It carries natural gas liquids through Deer Park and La Porte, both of which are southeast of Houston.
